realms.title: Realm 1: The Blizzard Arena · Save Sparky devlog
realms.name: The Blizzard Arena
realms.tagline: Nine enemies, each with its own fire, in a blizzard that has opinions.
realms.eyebrow: Save Sparky devlog · realm 1 · not boss patterns
realms.lede: Enemies whose attacks aren't boss patterns, each with its own fire. Drawn at the game's pixel scale in the blizzard arena, with Elfy for size. Every attack has a warning you can read from across the room: a pose, a sound made visible, a mark on the floor. Realm 2: the desert jungle.

fights.name: Brazier Knight
fights.eyebrow: 1 · Fire Ring
fights.lede: A squat iron knight whose helmet is an open brazier. Its head barely smoulders until it charges: it swings the sledgehammer back, the fire roars, the floor glows where it will land, and the slam sends a Fire Ring racing out along the ground. Jump the wave of flame at the ring's edge.
notes: Charge. At rest the head only smoulders. As it winds up, the fire roars, the eyes go white, wisps of flame stream into the hammer, and the floor glows where it will land.
Slam. The head erupts in a column of fire and the hammer smears down its arc: a white flash, rock chips and sparks, a short shake. After, the bowl is spent and smokes until it rekindles.
The wave. Flames are tallest at the ring's left and right edges and burn down fast behind them. Jump the edge and land in the cooling middle.
Back edge. In the pixelfx gallery the back of the ring floats about 18 px above the floor; here it lies on the snow. Toggle it to compare.

The full bout. Then the bout: bull rush (it drops its head, fire streaming back, the line marked, and charges the length of the room ploughing sparks; Elfy goes up onto the ledge), an uppercut that throws a crescent of fire at the ledge (she flips over him), a leap onto her marked spot that throws up a geyser, and in phase two the head-fire overflows (an aura, an impact frame) into a double slam whose second ring stands twice as tall. Weak window: the hammer sticks in the ground and its fire gutters to smoke.
fights.alt: The Brazier Knight slams its hammer and a ring of fire spreads along the snowy floor while Elfy jumps over it

fights.name: Kiln Cantor
fights.eyebrow: 2 · Fire Tornadoes · orange fire, teal and glass
fights.lede: A living bottle kiln on three bird legs, from a people who treat fire as music. It wears a ceremonial coat of woven heat-proof metal hung with glass chimes, and a collar of tuning forks. It sings fire: a fireball grows on its head and is lobbed straight at you, then eight more follow in a rapid barrage, each smaller and closer, each raising a funnel of fire.
notes: Warning. It rears back, arms up like a conductor. The tuning forks turn glass-blue and ring out in waves, sparks are drawn into a fireball growing on its head, and a target pulses on the floor under Elfy, faster as the ball swells.
The first shot. At full size the ball is lobbed high, right at Elfy, with a white flash of the silhouette and a freeze. The biggest funnel rises where it lands. Move off the target.
The barrage. Eight more, one every tenth of a second, each ball smaller and landing closer to the Cantor, so the funnels step down in size toward it. Each mark flashes just before its ball lands.

The funnels. Each forms rather than scales: a ring of flame spins up on the floor, a rope of fire climbs out of it, then the top flares open. They pull snow in round their feet and pinch back to a rope as they die.

The full bout. Then: it stomps after her and rams the ledge's post with its shoulder; its forks ring a shockwave she flips through; in phase two its kiln cracks white-hot and it sweeps a stream of fire along the floor and up the low ledge while she hides high behind it. Weak window: overheated, it slumps, steaming.
fights.alt: The Kiln Cantor charges a fireball on its head and lobs it at Elfy, then fires eight more in a rapid barrage, each smaller and closer, raising a row of shrinking fire tornadoes

fights.name: Ash Cartographer
fights.eyebrow: 3 · Star-fire Survey · cold star-fire, faded expedition orange
fights.lede: A six-limbed surveyor from a burned-out world, in a faded orange expedition suit with reflective stripes, map tubes strapped to its back and a folding visor arm. Its seed-pod head splits open to show the star inside. It maps a burn: three stakes, then columns of star-fire.
notes: Warning. It crouches low and wide, raises its sights, lowers the visor. The pod splits and the star inside charges, rays turning.
The survey. A dashed laser sweeps the floor and drops three stakes. Each gets a crosshair that tightens and blinks faster, with three pips that go out one by one.

Star-fire. The pod flies open and the body recoils as columns erupt left to right: white core, cyan, blue, a violet fringe that shivers like a split lens. A freeze on the first, a shake on each. The snow they touch turns to glittering glass.

The full bout. Now the survey hunts her: the last stake lands on her spot and she runs between the pillars. Then it scuttles in on six legs and pounces (body slam, after-images, an impact frame); in phase two it throws three stakes round her ledge and triangulates: the lines go live and close in, and collapse into one great pillar. Weak window: the star dims, the pod closes, it slumps.
fights.alt: The Ash Cartographer opens its pod head, a laser plants three survey stakes, then pillars of blue-white star-fire erupt from them in turn

fights.name: Hollow Courier
fights.eyebrow: 4 · Return to Sender · violet hellfire, black and crimson
fights.lede: A demon who delivers. A floating bell of a coat in black and crimson with brass buttons, a cracked porcelain mask under a courier's cap with a glowing badge, a satchel of sealed letters. Its letters burn violet. It throws one over your head; it hangs behind you, then comes back as lightning.
notes: Warning. It rises and leans back with one letter held high behind its head, its other hand pointing. The letter catches violet and the satchel glows.
Throw. The arm whips across, the coat flares back, and the letter flies end over end in a high arc over Elfy's head. It stops behind her and hangs there.
The tell. While it hangs, its seal pulses faster, a dashed line drops to the floor where the bolt will land, and chevrons crawl along the floor back toward the courier: the bolt's path.

Return to sender. The letter bursts into paper ash as lightning strikes straight down, with a flash, a freeze and a shake. Then the bolt runs back along the floor as a low crackling arc, scorching the snow. Jump it. The courier catches it in its glove, and bows.

The full bout. Then: a low swoop the length of the room (after-images; she goes up onto the ledge), registered mail (three burning letters hung round her, striking one after another, the last on her ledge), and in phase two it drinks the lightning back in, blinks above her and drops bell-first. Weak window: its satchel bursts and it scrabbles after its letters.
fights.alt: The Hollow Courier throws a burning letter over Elfy; it hangs behind her, then a violet lightning bolt strikes down and runs back along the floor to the courier while Elfy jumps it

fights.name: Vesper Maw
fights.eyebrow: 5 · Falling Star · astral prism, midnight velvet and gold
fights.lede: A bloated astronomer-priest that clings in the corner by six long legs, three on the ceiling and three on the wall. It wears a midnight robe embroidered with gold constellations, a pleated white ruff and gold bands on its legs, and orrery rings turn round its body. Its head is mostly mouth: needle teeth under a cluster of star-bright eyes. It swallows starlight and spits a falling star.
notes: Warning. It pulls back into the corner and the jaw unhinges. Starlight spirals into the mouth, its orrery rings spin faster, the sky dims, a glyph circle turns on the floor under Elfy, and in the last beat a dashed line shows the path the star will fall along.

The falling star. Not a burning rock: a prismatic crystal heart that shifts color, wrapped in two turning glyph rings with tiny planets circling it, trailing a tail that runs gold, pink, violet, teal into deep blue and sheds twinkling stars.

Impact. A white four-point star flashes across the screen, the longest freeze and hardest shake of any study, prismatic rings, crystal shards and stardust. Then a constellation draws itself above the crater, star by star, and fades. The snow is blasted to dark glass with glowing cracks.

The full bout. Then: it crawls along the ceiling and lashes its tongue down onto her (drool and a line warn first); in phase two it roars the sky dark and spits three stars that hang in a constellation whose lines go live, then fall; then it lets go and drops on her ringed spot. Weak window: sprawled on the snow, rings dim, until it leaps back to its corner.
fights.alt: The Vesper Maw, clinging in the top right corner, opens its toothed mouth, the sky dims, and it spits a prismatic falling star that strikes the floor and leaves a constellation in the air

fights.name: Sclera Magus
fights.eyebrow: 6 · Watchers · eclipse fire, bone and oxblood
fights.lede: A tall alien wizard that floats over a turning rune circle, ribbons trailing. Its head is a long pale cranium with one huge vertical eye and a fan of black spines behind it. It wears layered bone robes over an oxblood panel, a black mantle, a sash with an eye on it and a dagger-cut hem. Its fire is an eclipse: black cores, crimson rings, white-hot rims. It sends up a rocket, and what comes out of the burst is looking for you.
notes: Warning. It lifts both arms and an eclipse orb gathers between its hands, drinking in crimson motes. The great eye dilates and glows, and an eye-shaped reticle closes on Elfy.
The rocket. The orb climbs on a firework trail: white-hot behind it, cooling through rose and crimson and breaking up behind, glitter hanging and twinkling along it, the far end crackling.

The burst. A firework's streaks and glitter, but for a moment an eye opens in the sky. Five watchers fly out of it on drooping firework trails and hang there, blinking open one by one, pupils turning to Elfy, while the Magus points at her.

The dive. One after another they dive on the same crackling trails. Each locks onto where Elfy stands as it starts, steers there for a fifth of a second, then commits to a straight line. Move once they commit and they burst where you stood, in black smoke and crimson sparks.

The full bout. Then: it unravels and blinks beside her for an eclipse slash at waist height (she takes the ledge); in phase two its eye opens wide and an eye beam sweeps the floor and the ledge, and the ledge is cover: she crouches under it; then six watchers ring her and tighten until she flips out and they collide. Weak window: eye shut, it sinks into the snow.
fights.alt: The Sclera Magus floats, raises an eclipse orb and launches it as a rocket; it bursts into five eyes that stare at Elfy and dive at her one after another while she jumps clear

fights.name: Grinning Pyrocumulus
fights.eyebrow: 7 · Gale · a burning cloud, ash grey and ember red
fights.lede: A mushroom cloud that grins. A rolling cap of smoke lit red from the fire inside it, a stem feeding it, a condensation skirt, a dust surge at its foot. A wide Cheshire grin full of teeth and two crescent eyes. It drinks in the air, puffs its cheeks, purses its lips and blows, and the wind carries you back into the spikes.
notes: The face. The grin is the whole character: a wide Cheshire crescent of teeth over a burning throat, yellow crescent eyes. Drinking the air, the grin shrinks to a pucker, angry brows slant in, the eyes go wide and then white-hot, and the cheeks swell into two huge round puffs. Blowing, the lips purse into a glowing O with pucker wrinkles round it, the eyes scrunch shut, burning red, and the cheeks empty. After, the grin snaps back and it laughs.

Warning, in color. At rest it's grey smoke and yellow eyes. As it drinks, the fire climbs up through the cap, the face flushes ember red, the eyes whiten; it holds and trembles for a beat, the flush pulsing, before it blows. The inhale also pulls snow and ash from the whole room into its mouth, and in the last half second chevrons stream toward the pit and the spikes pulse red.

The body acts. It rears back and swells a third bigger (anticipation), snaps forward squashed wide the instant it blows, deflates through the gust, and wobbles back on a spring (overshoot and settle). The stem lags behind the cap and bends (follow-through). The ring round the stem circles behind it and in front. The base along the floor ripples like a wave: rolling out at rest, sucked in as it drinks, surging out as it blows.

The gale. A hard shake as it starts, then streaks of wind, blown snow and burning ash across the screen and a constant shake. Like Storm Eagle's gust, it doesn't hurt; it moves you. Elfy runs against it and still slides back, faster and faster, toward the edge.
The pit. Here she loses: over the edge onto the spikes, a freeze, a white flash and red sparks, and she bounces out blinking onto the far side. Jumping into the wind or holding a wall would save her.

The full bout. Then: it drifts over her and rains cinders down three marked lanes; it drinks again but now pulls her in and lunges down to chomp the floor (she escapes to the ledge); in phase two it rises burning and slams, smoke rolling out both ways. Weak window: deflated and panting.
fights.alt: The Grinning Pyrocumulus inhales with swelling cheeks, purses its lips and blows a gale that pushes Elfy back across the floor into a spike pit; she bounces out and it laughs

fights.name: Ion Gremlin
fights.eyebrow: 8 · Pitch · gold-magenta plasma, navy hazmat, an ice cave
fights.lede: A tiny imp with absurdly long arms, up on four long spider legs banded with glowing coils, in an ice cave by a cracked containment ring. It wears a puffy navy hazmat parka with reflective stripes and a fur-trimmed hood, its sleeves rolled up its long grey forearms, big brass goggles with plasma for lenses over a needle-toothed grin, and a long striped scarf. Its plasma runs white-hot through electric gold into hot magenta. It balls the plasma up and pitches it, then skitters in for a follow-up.
notes: The room. Still winter, but inside: an ice cave of crystal walls, icicles and crystal clusters, a faint aurora caught in the ice that brightens while it charges, and a cracked containment ring half sunk in the snow behind it, its coils glowing, spitting sparks, feeding it.

Warning. Its arms windmill overhead faster than you can follow while arcs leap from the ring into its fingertips, the finger claws and goggles go white-hot, a ball of plasma swells above its head, and a target pulses under Elfy.
The pitch. One arm whips out to over half again its length, rubber-hose, and the ball flies in a lob, stretching along its arc.
The mine. It sticks where it lands and pulses faster, drinking in snow, while a dashed dome shows exactly how far the blast will reach. Get outside the dome.

The blast. A white flash, then a ball of plasma swelling into a boiling shell that hollows out, shock rings tilted through it front and back, arcs crackling out into the floor, the longest freeze and hardest shake, glitter, melted snow. Then it cackles, its legs drumming the floor.

The legs. Four long spider legs, knees high over its little body, dark chitin banded with glowing magenta coils. They step in a scuttling rhythm as it skitters and drum and tap in a frenzy whenever it's excited, the way its arms windmill.

Follow-up: the lash. It skitters in, crouches low on its legs with both arms swung back and crackling, and a dashed line lights across the whole room at head height. Then it cracks a whip of plasma along that line, out to the wall. Crouch: Elfy kneels and it cracks over her head. Then it skitters home to its ring.

The full bout. Then: a full-tilt rush into the wall under her ledge, ricocheting out; in phase two it leaps onto the containment ring and drinks it (an impact frame), and pitches three plasma bombs at three marked domes, the last on her ledge, leaving one gap. Weak window: the ring backfires into it; frazzled and seeing stars.
fights.alt: In an ice cave the Ion Gremlin, up on spider legs, windmills its long arms, balls up gold and magenta plasma and pitches it; the ball sticks near Elfy and goes off as she jumps clear; then it skitters in and cracks a plasma lash across the room at head height while she crouches under it

fights.name: Madame Vesper & Little Tubbs
fights.eyebrow: 9 · The Lens and the Mortar · a pair: her magic, his fire
fights.lede: Two who fight as one. Madame Vesper is magic: an alien sorceress taller than anything in the room and thin as a reed, porcelain blue, a long neck and a long face with three rose eyes, black horns swept back and tipped in gold, a stiff fan collar, a narrow gown that bells into a train on the snow, and spider fingers. Little Tubbs is fire: a tiny round stoker wider than he is tall, coal-black skin cracked with embers, mustard overalls with brass buckles, a huge white mustache, a bowler with a stovepipe chimney that smokes, and a furnace door in his belly. She shapes; he burns.
notes: Always moving. She sways like a reed, more at the top than the hem, rose motes drifting off her fingers. He bobs on stubby legs, waddles, waves his tiny arms, his stovepipe puffing.

The lens. Warning: she points and a rose thread from her finger traces a seal in the air in front of them, runes turning inside it, while he breathes in, cheeks puffed, belly swelling, sparks sucked into his furnace door; a glowing line burns into the snow along the path. Then he spits one little spark through the seal, it flashes, and what comes out the other side is a roaring wheel of fire rolling across the room, melting a trench. Jump.

The mortar. Warning: she sweeps both arms up and lifts him in a rose bubble, legs kicking; he curls into a ball and catches fire; a target pulses under Elfy with a dashed dome over it. Then she flings him, and he arcs in, spinning, trailing embers, and slams down: a burst of flame the width of the dome, the hardest shake, snow thrown, a crater that glows and cools. Get outside the dome.
The pair. He pops out dizzy with stars round his hat and bounces home in two hops; she catches him on her thread and pats his hat while he laughs smoke rings out of his chimney.

The full bout. Phase two, pinball: she draws three seals in the air and curls Tubbs into a fireball, bats him, and he ricochets seal to seal, faster at each, down onto her mark; the path is drawn first. Weak window: he's dizzy and spent, she leans on her fan.
fights.alt: In the snow, the tall thin sorceress Madame Vesper traces a rose seal in the air while round little Tubbs breathes in; he spits a spark through the seal and it comes out a wheel of fire that rolls at Elfy, who jumps it. Then Vesper lifts Tubbs in a bubble, he curls into a burning ball, and she throws him at Elfy, who runs outside the marked dome before he slams down in a burst of fire. He bounces home dizzy, she catches him, and pats his hat as he laughs smoke rings.

realms.title: Realm 2: The Desert Jungle · Save Sparky devlog
realms.name: The Desert Jungle
realms.tagline: A jungle grown through a desert, a lava river on the horizon, and nine bosses who take water personally.
realms.eyebrow: Save Sparky devlog · realm 2 · the desert jungle
realms.lede: A new setting for water: a desert at dusk with a jungle grown through it, mesas and a low sun, a river of lava glowing across the middle distance, palms and hanging vines, sand that darkens where water touches it. Drawn at the game's pixel scale, with Elfy for size. Realm 1: the winter studies.

fights.name: Tide Contessa
fights.eyebrow: 1 · The Wave and the Piranhas · living water, coral and pearl
fights.lede: An elegant woman of moving water: an hourglass figure that ripples with light and bubbles, a coral corset trimmed with pearls, a scallop-shell tiara, long hair of streaming water that breaks into drops, and a skirt that pours down into the pool she rises from. She is never still. She sends a great wave, then piranhas out of her own body, then laughs.
notes: Always in motion. She sways in an S-curve, light ripples down her body and catches in sparkles, her hair streams back in long strands that drip from the tips, her skirt swirls into the pool and the pool rings.

The wave. Warning: she raises both arms, water and sand are drawn up into her and the pool swells, the wave's outline stands in front of her at its full height, and a wet line races across the sand along its path. Then she shoves both hands forward and a curling wave rolls the length of the room, a dark barrel under a lip of foam, spray off the top, lace trailing behind, the sand wet where it passed. Jump its crest.

The piranhas. Warning: she arches back with her arms spread, and you can see the fish circling inside her. Then they burst out of her one after another, silver-teal backs and red bellies, jaws snapping, and leap at where Elfy stood. They hit the sand, flop and flip, and dissolve into wet patches.
Ohohoho. Back of her hand to her mouth, eyes shut in happy arcs, leaning back. Every "ho" bounces her whole body, her bust a beat behind, and little HO letters bubble up and drift away.

The full bout. Then her riptide lash: she draws her arm back coiling water while a line blinks at head height, and a whip cracks the length of the room (crouch). In phase two she pours herself into her pool; a ring hunts Elfy along the sand and she erupts on a geyser where Elfy stood (dash out), then crashes down so crests roll out both ways (jump). Weak window: she melts into a puddle, two eyes blinking up, before welling up again in her pool.
fights.alt: In a desert jungle at dusk the Tide Contessa, a woman of water, raises a great curling wave that rolls at Elfy, who jumps its crest; then piranhas burst out of her body and leap at Elfy, flop on the sand and dissolve; then she laughs with her hand to her mouth, bouncing, little HO letters bubbling up

fights.name: Drowned Bather
fights.eyebrow: 2 · Geysers and the Drain · orb, geyser and whirlpool
fights.lede: Goofy from across the room, horrible up close. A gangly thing with a pot belly in a striped bathing costume, an inflatable life ring round its waist, skinny bowed legs and big flapping swim fins. On a long thin neck, a brass-collared diving helmet that is a sloshing orb of water, and floating inside it, its face: a pale drowned fish-thing with bulging, red-veined eyes that roll, a lipless mouth of needle teeth, a glowing lure. It stomps geysers up under you, then opens a whirlpool in the sand and drags you in.
notes: Geysers. It lifts a fin high and stomps, sand spraying, three times. Each stomp marks wherever Elfy stands: the sand darkens and burbles with bubbles and little plumes, and a dashed outline rises to show the column. Then a geyser blasts up, a churning foam head on a column of water, drops raining back down, steam, the sand left wet. Keep moving.

The drain. It hunches, arms out for a hug, the face in its helmet gaping. Spirals start turning in the sand in front of it. Then the floor opens: foam arms spiral into a dark eye, and sand, drops and you are all dragged in toward its fins. Elfy runs and still slides closer. It closes with a gulp and a burst of spray.

Goofy. The fins flap, the belly wobbles in its stripes, the life ring squeaks white and red, and after it drains you it does a little jig, fins slapping the sand. The water in its helmet sloshes with every stomp; its eyes never stop rolling.

The full bout. Then the belly flop: it squats, its landing outlined on the sand, leaps, turns over in the air and slams down on its belly (dash under). The flop cracks its helmet (phase two, a jet spurting from the crack). It bounces home on its life ring in three hops, each landing outlined (run under the high one), and lands into three geysers at once (stand in the gap). Weak window: its helmet runs dry and the fish-face gasps in the empty glass.
fights.alt: The Drowned Bather, a pot-bellied thing in a striped bathing costume with a water-filled diving helmet for a head, stomps three geysers up under Elfy as she runs, then opens a whirlpool in the sand that drags her toward it

fights.name: Bishop Bubblegulp
fights.eyebrow: 3 · Eye Bubbles and the Downpour · bubbles, fountain, waterfall, rain
fights.lede: A fat axolotl-toad wizard sitting cross-legged in a stone fountain basin that floats on glowing runes, spilling two little waterfalls onto the sand. Frilly pink gills that glow at the tips, bulging gold eyes, a goofy grin, and a third eye in its brow that splits open when it casts. A peacock robe with gold runes and a high collar, a tall crooked hat whose tip is a fountain spout, and a bubble-wand for a staff.
notes: Always busy. It bobs in its basin over a ring of runes, its gills flutter, its eyes blink out of step, its hat sprays water in arcs, its tongue lolls out now and then, and the basin keeps overflowing in two little waterfalls that splash and wet the sand.

Eye bubbles. Warning: it dips its wand in the basin, the loop fills with a shimmering rainbow film, the third eye opens and its cheeks puff out. Then it blows five big wobbling rainbow bubbles, each with an eyeball inside it staring at Elfy, drifting toward her. They pop in a spray, the eyes fall out and burst on the sand.

The downpour. Warning: it raises its staff, the hat's fountain surges up in a spiral and a storm cloud spreads over the room; then a drop shadow pulses on the sand in every lane but one. Then glowing rain hammers down those lanes, each drop landing in a little crown, the sand turning to puddles. Stand in the gap.
Croak. Its throat sac swells into a bubble as big as its head and pops, CROAK, and it claps its webbed hands.

The full bout. Then the basin ram: the basin tilts back, runes flaring, its path lit along the floor, and it charges the length of the room into the wall (double jump over its hat). From the wall in phase two its tongue lashes across the room at head height (crouch), then it bounces bubbles along the floor, each landing outlined (double jump). Weak window: it floats home, the basin tips into the sand and it sees stars.
fights.alt: Bishop Bubblegulp, an axolotl-toad wizard in a floating fountain basin, blows rainbow bubbles with eyeballs in them at Elfy, then raises a storm from its fountain hat and rains on every lane but one while Elfy stands in the gap; then its throat sac swells and pops with a CROAK

fights.name: Siphon & Sever
fights.eyebrow: 4 · The Bridge, the Relay and the Boil · two tiny water assassins at a lava ford
fights.lede: A pair that only works together, at a ford where the floor is cut by a pit of lava. Siphon is the caster: a floating thing in ultraviolet rags with a hood swept back to a point, a bone beak-mask with one cold eye and a pinprick for the other, a glass flask of glowing brine for a heart, and no legs, only a dripping rope of water. Sever is the blade: a reverse-kneed runt in midnight armor, a crest of chrome fins, hot pink eyes, a long yellow scarf, and a whip of brine on its wrist. Neither ever stands still.
notes: The lava is the third enemy. A pit in the floor between Elfy and the pair, always spitting embers, lighting its walls, the sand scorched black at its lip. They use water to change it: harden it, cross it, boil it.

The bridge and the lash. Warning: the bridge's outline blinks over the pit while Siphon's flask glows. Siphon pours brine from its beak in a sweep and the lava hisses into a glowing crust that cools to obsidian. Sever coils, eyes flaring, and a line skims the sand at shin height. Then it sprints across, leaving afterimages, skids, and snaps the whip low. Jump. It backflips home, and the bridge cracks and sinks.

The relay. Siphon bursts into water and re-forms high up, claws raised, drawing brine out of the air into a sphere. Sever coils under it and three lines reach for Elfy's head. Siphon drops it, Sever leaps and front-flips and whips it, and it bursts into three crescent blades that scream over the lava, steam hissing under them. Crouch.

The boil. Siphon floats over the pit and empties its heart into the lava. The lava heaves, the outline of a pillar rises over it and rings mark the sand where it will land; Sever retreats spinning its whip. Then the pit blows: a pillar of steam lit orange, lava thrown in arcs onto both shores, scorch that glows and cools. Step back.
The pair. Sever flips up and perches on Siphon's hood, crouched, scarf streaming, eyes flaring in time; then drops off and they start again.

The full bout. In phase two Sever curls into a spin dash, its path lit along the floor: it rolls, hops the pit, hits the wall and rebounds high over Elfy (jump the roll). Siphon rises over her, its landing outlined, and dives (dash out), a crest running out from the slam (jump). Weak window: both spent, seeing stars.
fights.alt: At a lava pit in the desert floor, Siphon, a hooded floating caster, pours brine over the lava to harden an obsidian bridge; Sever, a tiny scarfed runner, sprints across and lashes at Elfy's shins as she jumps, then backflips home as the bridge sinks. Siphon blinks high and draws a sphere of water; Sever leaps and whips it into three blades that fly over the crouching Elfy. Siphon empties its flask into the lava, which blows up in a pillar of steam and throws lava where Elfy stood; Sever perches on Siphon's hood.

fights.name: The Thunderbell
fights.eyebrow: 5 · The Lightning Call · a prism jellyfish at the oasis
fights.lede: A jellyfish grown into a monster, floating over the jungle floor of a desert oasis while a volcano bleeds lava on the horizon. Its bell is see-through and banded in every color, sliding through them as it pulses; a gold circlet round its rim hangs with charms. Its face never stops making faces. Two of its tentacles have grown into long arms with clawed hands; the rest trail under it, glinting with charge. It raises a claw, marks Elfy with a sigil, darkens the sky, and calls the lightning down on her.
notes: The scene. Still the desert, at dusk: a volcano on the horizon with lava pulsing down its flanks and a plume lit red from inside; a little oasis in the dunes, a pool ringed with reeds and leaning palms; and the floor overgrown with jungle, broad split leaves, ferns, tall grass, pink and gold flowers, fireflies.

The face. Big eyes that track Elfy and blink, thick brows that carry its mood, a mouth that smirks, snarls a grin of needle teeth, roars wide with a long blue tongue, then laughs with its eyes squeezed shut and its cheeks flushed. Its eyes flash white with the strike.

The arms. Its left and right tentacles are arms: long, ropy, prismatic, ending in hands with four clawed fingers that splay, clutch, crook into a claw while it calls the storm, and point when it brings the bolt down.

Warning. The claw goes up crackling, a thread of static running from it into the sky; a sigil of turning dashes draws itself on the sand under Elfy and charges brighter, static rising off it; then the whole sky goes dark and the leader feels its way down in steps while a streamer climbs out of the sigil to meet it.

The strike. On the downswing a thick bolt slams into Elfy, then two more strokes down the same channel. She jolts: flashes blue-white, her outline lit through on the brightest flickers, sparks crawling over her, thrown back a step with each stroke, shivering. Cracks race out across the sand, glow with heat and cool to scorch; she kneels, smoking, and gets back up.
Then it laughs. HA HA bubbling up out of its mouth, its bell bouncing, its hands clutching itself.

The full bout. In phase two it drifts in close, then drops low with its tentacles live while the floor lights up the length of the room, and sweeps into the far wall (double jump over it). From the wall it calls a chain: a sigil, then a bolt, three of them walking after Elfy (run ahead). Weak window: overcharged, it slumps on the sand, fizzing, eyes rolled shut.
fights.alt: At a desert oasis with jungle plants and a smoking volcano, a prismatic jellyfish monster with a face raises a clawed tentacle-arm crackling with static; a sigil draws itself under Elfy, the sky goes dark, and on the downswing a thick bolt of lightning strikes her three times; she flashes blue-white, is thrown back shivering and smoking, and the monster laughs HA HA

fights.name: The Weeping Palm
fights.eyebrow: 6 · The Coconut Bomb · a sad robot archer at the oasis
fights.lede: A palm tree that is a robot, and is very sad about it. A riveted bronze trunk in rings like a palm's, slumped forward; a little screen for a face with amber eyes that droop at the corners and leak oil; a crown of patina-green metal fronds that hang down like a willow's; six roots it walks on like a spider. On its back, a big woven quiver of coconut bombs with fuses. One of its boughs is a bow. It is good at this, and it isn't happy about that either.
notes: Sad and droopy. Its fronds hang heavier when it sighs, a puff of steam from the vent in its crown, a little ellipsis floating up. Its amber eyes sag at the corners, its brows lift in the middle, its frown wobbles, and every so often a drop of oil runs down its screen. After it hits Elfy it feels worse.
Root legs. Six roots in two tripods, brass knuckles at the joints, tips curled to dig in, scuttling it in and out like a spider and scuffing the sand.

The shot (after the pixelfx arrow shot). It reaches back into the quiver for a coconut, flicks a spark to light the fuse, raises the bow, nocks, draws to its face, and holds its breath, trembling, straightened for once. Warning: while it holds, the lob's arc is dotted out and a ring marks the sand at Elfy's feet. Then the string snaps forward and the coconut lobs, spinning, fuse spitting sparks.
The fuse. It lands at her feet and fizzes, the fuse burning down, a dashed dome of the blast blinking faster and faster. She turns to run, too late.

The hit (after the pixelfx meteor call and rocket launcher). The longest freeze, a white flash, a fireball that swells and rises, a shock ring along the sand, the hardest shake, shell and sand and embers thrown, a column of smoke. Elfy is thrown up and back, lands on one knee charred black with embers glowing in the soot, smoking, and only slowly comes clean again before she walks back.

The full bout. It has had enough: its screen goes red and it flings three bombs at once, each landing ringed, each blast dome blinking (dash out from under all three). Then it rears back, its crown's reach outlined on the sand, and throws its whole body down so the crown slams the floor (back off). Weak window: its crown is stuck in the sand; hit its face before it wrenches free.
fights.alt: A droopy palm-tree robot walks in on six spidery roots and sighs steam; it reaches into the quiver on its back for a coconut bomb, lights the fuse, nocks it on a bow made from a bough, draws and holds while a dotted arc and a ring mark Elfy; it looses, the coconut lobs and lands fizzing at her feet, a dome blinks faster, she turns to run too late, and the bomb goes off: a white flash and a fireball throw her back charred and smoking; the palm shuffles away, sadder

fights.name: Abbot Barnacle, the Brine Organ
fights.eyebrow: 7 · Chords · bubbles, ripples and a waterfall from a huge crab
fights.lede: A colossal hermit crab filling a third of the room, standing in a tide pool of its own making. Its shell is a cathedral pipe organ grown out of coral and barnacles. Two eyes on long stalks wear tiny round spectacles; it has a great crusher claw and a spindly one it conducts with, and a moth-eaten choir robe hemmed in gold draped over its legs. It plays itself: every attack is a chord.
notes: Every move is animated. Anticipation: before each chord it rises and draws breath, its shell stretching tall, its spindly claw lifting like a baton. Squash and stretch: on the chord it slams down, the shell squashing wide, the pipes stretching as they blow. Follow-through: it overshoots and settles on a spring, and its eyestalks whip and wobble long after the body stops. Slow in and out on every pose, a snap on every strike, and arcs for the claw.

The bubble sheet. Warning: a band of sand under Elfy fizzes and its edges are outlined up to where the bubbles will go off. Then a curtain of bubbles rises, every size, wobbling and swelling as they climb, lit rims and see-through bodies. The first to reach the top pop, each one a white flash, a ring and a spray, and sets off its neighbours a beat later: the whole sheet goes off like a string of firecrackers. Three chords, three sheets, each aimed where Elfy went.
The ripple drum. It lifts its legs under the robe (anticipation), slams them down, and a glossy crest of water runs out along the sand, three in a row, on the beat. Jump each one.

The fire hose. Warning: it rears the crusher claw back low, bubbles gurgling at its tip, and a dotted aim line runs from the claw to Elfy. Then it thrusts the claw straight out and fires a pressurised jet like a fireman's hose: a glassy rod with surges running down it, sagging under its own weight, roughening and breaking into chunks toward the far end. It blasts Elfy back across the sand in a burst of spray, and the kick shoves the crab back on its legs, the claw shuddering with the pressure.

A Muppet mouth. The top of its carapace is hinged at the back and lifts off the mouth line like a Muppet's head: shut for a breath before each chord, then flung wide to sing it; a chomp on every drum; gritted while it hoses; and after it blasts Elfy it flaps with laughter, mouth dark, tongue and little teeth showing, its eyestalks riding up and down on the lid.
Weak window. Played out, its eyestalks droop all the way down to the sand and it wipes its spectacles with a little cloth.

The full bout. In phase two it scuttles in and rears its crusher claw high, its landing outlined (dash back), and smashes it into the sand. Stuck, it panics into a full organ: every pipe at once, bubble bombs lobbed onto ringed spots (stand in the gap). Weak window: spent, pipes venting steam, claw buried; jump the claw and hit its face before it wrenches free.
fights.alt: A huge hermit crab with a pipe organ for a shell rises and draws breath, conducts with a spindly claw and squashes down on a chord; a band of sand fizzes under Elfy and a curtain of bubbles rises and goes off like firecrackers, three times, while Elfy steps out of each band; then it drums its legs and crests of water run along the sand for Elfy to jump; then it rears its claw back, thrusts it out and blasts Elfy across the sand with a jet like a fire hose; then its eyestalks droop and it wipes its spectacles

fights.name: Captain Sump
fights.eyebrow: 8 · Mines, the Drop and the Wash · a diving bell riding its own water jet
fights.lede: A portly brass diving bell in a navy admiral's coat, gold epaulettes and a bicorne, floating on a pressurised jet of water from a nozzle centered under its body. Its face is a porthole with one huge magnified eye and a brass shutter for an eyelid, under kelp brows and over a great drooping kelp mustache; two octopus tentacles curl out of its rivet holes.
notes: Always on the jet. It bobs on the pressure surges, the bell squashing and stretching with them; a foaming skirt boils where the jet lands; its epaulette fringe, mustache, tentacles and hat all swing a beat behind every move.

Bilge mines. It puffs up tall (anticipation), then bloops three water orbs out of its side vents, squashing with each one. They float out in arcs toward Elfy, wobbling, the floor showing upside down through them, a burst ring around each blinking faster before they go off in a crown of spray.

Jet drop. It climbs over Elfy in an arc, a target marks the sand, the jet sputters and coughs. Then it cuts: it hangs a beat looking down, falls stretched, slams down with the hardest shake, and two crests of water skim out both ways. Jump them.
Weak window. Jet gone, it bounces across the sand in squashing hops, hat flopping, eye spinning behind the glass, until it re-pressurises with a cough and a whoosh and shoots back up.

Point-blank. Re-pressurised, it flies in close to Elfy, winds back the other way (anticipation), then swings round until its nozzle faces her, overshooting and settling, while an aim line blinks. Then it fires: the jet slams into her and drives her back across the sand, and the recoil hurls the captain away across the room. It swings back upright with a wobble, its hat bouncing on its own spring.

The full bout. In phase two it swings its nozzle round backward, sputters while a corridor at head height lights across the room (crouch), and torpedoes the length of the room on its own jet into the wall. Weak window: crumpled on the sand, porthole cracked, eye spinning, before it re-pressurises and flies home.
fights.alt: A diving-bell captain hovering on a water jet puffs up and bloops three water orbs that drift at Elfy and burst; then it climbs over her, its jet sputters and cuts, it hangs, falls and slams down, crests of water skimming out that Elfy jumps; it bounces helplessly, eye spinning, until it re-pressurises; then it flies in close, swings round to aim its nozzle at Elfy and blasts her back, the recoil hurling it away

fights.name: Little Mother Drain
fights.eyebrow: 9 · Plugholes, Teapots and a Leaky Ceiling · a tiny hag who travels by whirlpool
fights.lede: A tiny hag, knee-high to Elfy, made of wet hair and a ladle: a soaked lace bonnet with its ties hanging, a knit cardigan with too many pockets, all of it dripping; two pinprick lights for eyes and a gummy grin with one tooth; a bathtub plug on a chain dragging behind her. She never walks. She goes down one whirlpool and comes up another. Here, under a rock overhang that drips.
notes: Plughole hop. Warning: foam starts turning in the sand beside Elfy. She squashes down (anticipation), hops up stretched, and spins down into her whirlpool; then shoots up out of the new one stretched tall, squashes, and winds the ladle back before swinging it round in a big arc with a smear. Its whirlpool pulls at Elfy while she's beside it, so she has to run against it.

Teapot fountains. She slaps the sand with the ladle three times, squashing on each slap, and a porcelain teapot pops up at each: their landing rings show on the sand first. Then they bloom: a jet out of each spout throwing glassy arcs that break into beads and rain down on the rings in little plinks.

Leaky ceiling. She shakes her ladle at the rock overhead, trembling with it. Drips swell on the ceiling, sagging and catching the light, their shadows growing on the sand; then they pinch off one after another and fall stretched by their speed, landing in crowns, leaving one dry spot.

Weak window. She can't use the same whirlpool twice in a row, so she spins down to come up somewhere new, and that somewhere is right under Elfy. She bonks her head on Elfy's foot, squashes flat, and sits there seeing stars before she sinks away and comes up home.
Follow-through. Her curtain of wet hair, the bonnet ties and the plug on its chain all swing a beat behind every hop, slap and spin.

The full bout. In phase two she squats and starts to turn, ladle out, the floor lit to the wall, and goes off like a spinning top across the sand (jump her), ricochets off the wall and spins back (jump again). Weak window: dizzy and wobbling, seeing stars, before she sinks away home.
fights.alt: A tiny hag in a lace bonnet squashes, hops and spins down a whirlpool and comes up out of another beside Elfy, swinging her ladle round in an arc while its pull drags at Elfy; she slaps three teapots into the sand that bloom into fountains raining beads onto marked rings; she shakes her ladle at the ceiling and drips swell, pinch off and fall in crowns; then she spins down to come up under Elfy and bonks her head on Elfy's foot, seeing stars

realms.title: Realm 3: The Hell Cavern · Save Sparky devlog
realms.name: The Hell Cavern
realms.tagline: Ice in hell: lava falls, violet soulfire, and a chandelier that eats ceilings.
realms.eyebrow: Save Sparky devlog · realm 3 · the hell cavern
realms.lede: Ice in hell. A basalt cavern under the world: lava falls pouring off ledges into a river glowing behind the floor, stalactites, and against all that red a second colour, ultraviolet soulfire in iron braziers and violet crystal veins in the rock. Embers rise from where the heat is, ride the updrafts, pool on the ceiling and fall as ash; ice snuffs them, and frost turns lava to black glass that thaws again. Drawn at the game's pixel scale, with Elfy for size. Realm 1 · Realm 2.

fights.name: The Icebox Family
fights.eyebrow: 1 · Nova, Breath, Whack · a triple combo
fights.lede: Three who fight as one. Papa Fridge, a hulking rounded refrigerator on clawed casters in a maroon bathrobe, his face a set of fridge magnets that rearrange themselves with his mood and his freezer door for a mouth. Grandma Freezerburn, a frost ghost in a lavender shawl and pearls, knitting needles in her ghostly hands, her head an ice crystal turning in its own cold light with a face of cracks. Cubey, a tiny ice-cube-tray kid on stubby legs, each cube one pixel of his face, with a mallet.
notes: 1 · Grandma's frost nova. Warning: she floats over and winds up, rising and stretching, her crystal spinning faster, frost spiralling in, her shawl flaring, a ring on the floor showing how far it will reach. Then a white flash, a snowflake, and three rings of ice crystals bloom out. Every ember they cross dies in a hiss of steam and falls as ash. Elfy is chilled: frost ferns creep up her and she can only crawl.

2 · Papa's frost breath. Warning: he rolls in on his casters, then rears back and swells up with his door clamped shut, his magnets bunching into a scowl, the cone of the breath outlined. Then the freezer door flies open on icicle teeth and he blasts: billowing frost, wind streaks, tumbling crystals. Frost races up Elfy and a faceted block crystallises round her pane by pane, a glint sweeping across it. The lava fall behind them freezes to black glass with glowing cracks and thaws back from the top later.

3 · Cubey's whack. He runs in on his stubby legs, goes up on his toes and winds the mallet way back (the biggest anticipation in the fight). Cracks race over the block; then the swing, a white flash, and the block bursts into chunks that tumble, bounce and skid while Elfy flies free, landing on one knee, still frosted.
The family. Papa laughs with his door flapping and his letter magnets bouncing, Grandma spins, Cubey hops round with a grin made of cubes; then they go home.

The cavern. Embers born at the foot of each fall, in pops on the river and in violet sparks off the soulfire, climbing the updrafts and pulled in toward them, pooling on the ceiling and coming down as ash; cinders that tumble and crack in two; a burning fleck now and then; big soft embers out of focus in front of everything; the air over the river shimmering; and every few seconds the whole cavern swells, a heartbeat.

The full bout. In phase two Papa charges: he rears back, casters spitting sparks, the lane to the wall lit, and rolls the length of the room (double jump over him). He hits the wall and goes over. Weak window: flat on his back, door flapping, while Cubey hops about behind him. He rights himself and rolls home (hop him again).
fights.alt: In a hell cavern of lava falls and violet soulfire, a frost ghost with an ice-crystal head winds up and blooms rings of ice crystals that chill Elfy and slow her; a fridge in a bathrobe rolls in, rears back and throws open its freezer-door mouth, breathing frost that freezes Elfy solid in a block of ice and turns a lava fall to black glass; a tiny ice-cube-tray kid runs in, winds his mallet way back and whacks the block, which bursts into chunks as Elfy flies free; the family cheers

fights.name: Saint Rime, the Frost Chandelier
fights.eyebrow: 2 · Icicles, Breath and the Fall · it walks on the ceiling
fights.lede: A cathedral chandelier that became a predator. A cage of black iron rimed with frost, carried upside-down across the ceiling and down the walls on six long jointed legs that end in hooks. Candles burn on its arms with cold blue flame, crystal prisms swing beneath it, and a veil of torn frozen lace hangs round its heart: a drum of porcelain masks, serene, weeping, screaming, sleeping. Before every attack it ticks round to a new face. No ember survives near it.
notes: The masks are the warning. The drum ticks round, the porcelain turning edge-on and back, to the face of what's coming: weeping before the icicles, screaming before the breath, sleeping before it drops, then snapping to screaming as it lets go.

Icicle fall. It crawls the length of the ceiling on its tripod gait, prisms swinging behind it, and icicles grow in its wake. They drip and tremble while their shadows sharpen on the floor, then snap off their roots in sequence and stab down, bursting into skidding shards.

Frost breath. It goes over the corner and down the wall, hanging off it sideways, and draws back against the rock (anticipation) while the mask's mouth opens and fills with white light; the breath's corridor is outlined across the room. Then it screams frost the width of the cavern: every ember in its path dies to steam and ash, and the lava falls freeze to black glass one after another as it reaches them. Crouch under it.

The fall. It crosses back to hang over Elfy; its candles flare; a target and the reach of the spikes show on the floor. It lets go, legs folding in as it falls, and crashes: a frost nova, chunks of ice, and a frost line racing out both ways with clusters of ice spikes bursting up behind it, glinting, and shattering. Jump them.
Weak window. It lies crumpled on its back, legs twitching, the mask turned up, until a chain drops from the ceiling and it winches itself back up, legs dangling.

The full bout. In phase two it crawls to the middle of the ceiling and lowers itself on a chain, the whole arc of the swing dashed out, and swings the room like a pendulum, legs out, candles flaring (stay crouched). The chain snaps, its landing outlined, and it crashes; ice spikes race out both ways (jump). Weak window: crumpled on the floor, the weeping mask, before it winches itself up.
fights.alt: A huge iron chandelier with hooked legs crawls upside-down across the ceiling of a lava cavern, turning a porcelain mask to a weeping face, icicles growing in its wake that snap and stab the floor in sequence; it climbs down the wall, turns to a screaming mask and breathes frost across the room while Elfy crouches, turning the lava falls to glass; then it hangs over Elfy, lets go, crashes and sends a wave of ice spikes racing out that Elfy jumps, lies wrecked, and winches itself back up on its chain

fights.name: The Clerk of Rime
fights.eyebrow: 3 · The Seal, the Lances and the Stamp · it climbs and leaps
fights.lede: A towering, stilt-thin thing in a long black greatcoat with a collar of ice shards, frost dripping off its hem. Its head is a window pane in an iron frame, fogged over; on the inside something draws a face in the frost with a fingertip, wipes it, and draws another. A ledger is chained to one wrist and it carries a heavy iron seal in the other hand. It goes where it pleases: it seals a lava fall solid and climbs it, and leaps between the platforms that hang on chains.
notes: The face in the glass. Every time its mood changes a fingertip-wide streak wipes the frost clear, and the new face is drawn back in stroke by stroke: blank, then narrowed, then a glare, then a grin. The window is lit violet from inside.

The seal and the ladder. It brings its seal down on a lava fall: a glyph of frost flashes on it and the fall freezes to glass, top to bottom. It climbs it like a ladder, hand over hand, and steps off onto the highest platform.

Ice lance. Warning: it leans back, frost gathering into a spear in its long fingers, an aim line to Elfy. Then it throws: a faceted lance, a pulse of light running down its core, rings of cold shearing off the tip, a frost wake. It stabs into the floor and bursts.

Leap and stamp. It crouches (anticipation), springs stretched, arcs across with its coat-tails trailing, and lands squashing; it stamps the platform with the seal, a white line runs down to the floor, and a frost line races out along it with clusters of ice spikes bursting up behind. Jump them.

The volley. A great leap off the high platform; at the top it hangs with every lance raised while three marks blink on the floor; it throws all three as it falls and lands in a crouch that shakes the room. Then it writes in its ledger: the weak window.

The full bout. In phase two it slams the ledger shut and strides at Elfy. The seal goes up overhead, its glyph's landing outlined (dash back), comes down, and the glyph bursts into a pillar of ice. Then it spins, its coat-tails throwing a ring of frost round at shin height (jump). Weak window: it overbalances onto one knee.
fights.alt: A tall thin figure in a black greatcoat with a window-pane head stamps a lava fall with an iron seal, freezing it, and climbs it to a hanging platform; it throws ice lances down at Elfy, leaps from platform to platform stamping frost lines that race along the floor and burst into ice spikes that Elfy jumps; then it leaps high, raises a volley of three lances and throws them as it falls, and writes in its ledger

fights.name: The Snowglobe Oracle
fights.eyebrow: 4 · Vortex, Burst and Freeze · it floats
fights.lede: A great snowglobe floating over the lava, a little dead village of black spires inside it with a few windows still lit, on a collar of gold clockwork, a fortune-teller's violet shawl hung from it with gold tassels, chains of charms dangling below. It has no face of its own. The snow inside settles into one; when it shakes, the face blows apart into a blizzard and settles again, worse. Every attack cracks its glass a little more, and snow leaks out of the cracks.
notes: Its faces. Flakes of snow drift through the dead village and settle into a face: watching, then staring, then raging with teeth, then a grin. Before each attack it shakes and the face blows apart into a swirling blizzard inside the glass, then settles into the next.

Blizzard vortex. It shakes, then turns itself slowly upside down (overshooting and settling), the village hanging from the top; its path is marked on the floor. Snow pours out of its lid into a funnel that stands up off the floor, bands of snow spinning in front of it and behind, snow boiling at its foot. Then the funnel comes loose and stalks across the room, dragging at Elfy while she runs against it, every ember dying in it, until it collapses in a burst of snow.
Snowflake burst. Frost gathers in a ring round it, closing in; then a cold flash and big six-armed snowflakes spin out, slow, tumble and drift down; where they settle the floor rimes white.

The freeze. A grinning face settles, and Elfy's own reflection appears in the glass, small and warped, and frosts over from the feet up while frost creeps across the floor to her. Then it happens to her: frost races up her and she is sealed in a faceted block. She shakes, the block cracks, and she bursts free.
Weak window. Spent, it dims and sags toward the floor, and frost slowly seals the cracks in its glass.

The full bout. In phase two a raging face: it rises shaking, its landing and its lane outlined, and the glass drops out of its collar and rolls the room like a boulder (double jump over), smashing into the wall. Weak window: cracked, leaking snow, while its empty collar and shawl hang where it was; then it floats back up into them, spinning.
fights.alt: A floating snowglobe whose snow settles into a face shakes, turns itself upside down and pours a snow tornado that stalks across a lava cavern while Elfy runs against its pull; it rights itself, frost gathers round it and it bursts out spinning six-armed snowflakes that settle and rime the floor; then Elfy's reflection appears in its glass and frosts over, frost creeps across the floor and she is frozen in a block of ice that cracks until she breaks free; the globe dims and its cracks frost over

fights.name: Maestro Ohm and the Sparkflies
fights.eyebrow: 5 · The Overture and the Crescendo · lightning: a conductor and its swarm
fights.lede: The lightning begins. A gaunt alien conductor, too tall, in a tattered tailcoat with a violet lining and a stiff high collar. Its head is a brass gramophone horn turned toward you; inside the bell, two cold eyes slide slowly round the rim and a mouth opens at the bottom. Its baton is a lightning rod wound in copper. Out of its coat-tails come the Sparkflies, balls of lightning with crackling wings, and they carry the current wherever it points.
notes: The overture. Its coat-tails open and the Sparkflies hatch one after another, drifting out in arcs into a loose net across the room. Warning: it raises the baton high and holds it still, the other hand clawing the air; sparks pour into the tip until it's white, the cavern darkens round it, and faint links flicker from fly to fly. Then it snaps the baton down like a whip and the lightning leaps from the baton through every fly into Elfy, three strokes down the same path, every ember along it flaring white. Elfy is electrified: she flashes, lit through on the brightest flickers, sparks crawling over her, jittering, thrown back.
Break the chain. In the game, every fly is a link: kill one and the lightning fizzles at the gap.

The crescendo. It conducts faster and faster, both arms whipping, coat-tails flying. The flies leave the net and ring Elfy, orbiting faster, tightening, crackling to one another. Get out of the ring. Then they all discharge into the centre at once and burn out, their husks dropping and smoking.
Weak window. Spent, it hunches, and its coat-tails slowly open to hatch the next swarm.

The full bout. In phase two it stands en garde, the baton a crackling rapier, a line at chest height (dash back), and lunges the length of the room in one stride. It drives the rod into the floor and the current runs out along it both ways (jump). Weak window: grounded and drained, hunched over its rod, before it pulls it free.
fights.alt: A tall conductor with a gramophone horn for a head hatches lightning bugs from its coat-tails that drift into a net across the room; it raises its baton, sparks pour into it, the cavern darkens, and it snaps the baton down: chain lightning leaps from the baton through every bug into Elfy, who is electrified; then it conducts faster, the bugs ring Elfy crackling, she runs out of the ring and they all discharge into the centre and burn out; it hunches and slowly hatches new ones

fights.name: The Ladder
fights.eyebrow: 6 · The Metronome, the Crawlers and the Overload · lightning on a beat
fights.lede: Meat grafted into machinery. A bloated, stitched body of pale flesh strapped into a brass harness, a stained leather surgeon's apron hanging off it, a welding mask pushed up on its crown. Its face is a cage of ribs that swings open like a gate on a single wet lens, an iris of brass blades focusing in and out. Two antennae of copper rails rise from it and four long railed legs carry it; up the antennae and down the legs the sparks climb, widening as they go, a ladder of lightning.
notes: The ladders. On every pair of rails a spark is always climbing: up the antennae, widening between the rails as it rises, and down each leg into the floor, where it fizzles. Its lens's iris closes to a pinhole each time it takes aim.

The metronome. The spark reaches the top of the antennae exactly on the beat, pops, and flies at Elfy as a crescent of lightning: tick, tick, tick, TOCK. The beat is the warning, a pulse at its feet before each one, and the height alternates: high (crouch), low (jump), high (crouch). Then the TOCK, a big one, and Elfy is electrified.

Ground ladder. Its legs glow and the sparks running down them don't stop at the floor: they crawl along it toward Elfy as zigzag sparks, between crescents up high, so she has to read low and high at once.
Overload. It squats and swells, every ladder racing at once, the rib gate rattling; then it slams down and a ring of arcs races out along the floor both ways. Jump it.
Weak window. Spent, it vents steam from its seams and its rib gate hangs wide open on the lens.

The full bout. In phase two it hops toward Elfy on its four rails, rears with its antennae crackling, the landing outlined under her (dash under), and pounces, slamming its whole body down; a ring of arcs runs both ways (jump). Weak window: sprawled, the rib gate hanging open on the lens. It leaps home over her, its arc dotted (get low).
fights.alt: A flesh-and-brass creature with spark-climbing antennae and railed legs fires crescents of lightning at Elfy on a steady beat, high, low, high, which she crouches and jumps, then a big one that electrifies her; then sparks crawl along the floor from its legs between bolts up high; then it squats, every ladder running at once, and slams a ring of arcs out along the floor that she jumps; then it vents steam with its rib gate hanging open

fights.name: Lady Nimbus
fights.eyebrow: 7 · Touch, Uncorked and the Thunderclap · a storm in a glass, with wings
fights.lede: A lady of the storm, floating. Her head is a glass globe with a living storm trapped inside, and like a plasma globe its lightning reaches for the glass wherever something comes near: it always points at Elfy. She has no face of her own; a face shows only for the frame the storm flashes, in silhouette, a different one each time. A Victorian bodice with a high lace collar and a cameo, long black gloves, a veil hanging from the globe, and below the waist her gown is the storm cloud itself, raining. And wings of storm-feathers, bruise-dark with violet edges, every quill lit white when it lightnings.
notes: Touch. Warning: the lightning in her globe bunches against the glass on Elfy's side, brighter and thicker, and a ring marks the floor. Then it punches through the glass as a bolt; the glass cracks a little.

Uncorked. She lifts the crystal stopper off the top of her head and the storm pours out and spreads across the ceiling, glowing from inside. Warning: lanes light up, glowing patches under the cloud and on the floor. Then lightning strikes down them in a ripple; where a lane crosses the lava river, molten rock is thrown up. Stand in the gap.

Thunderclap. The resurrection wings: an arm that folds and spreads, every feather posed on its own. Warning: she rises, her wings lift high and fold far back, and the storm in her globe goes dark and silent. Then one great downbeat, with motion trails: a white flash, a shock ring, a gust that throws Elfy back across the floor and drives every ember sideways. Feathers tear loose and drift down charged, lying on the floor sizzling.
Weak window. Her wings are ragged, bald in patches, and grow back feather by feather.
Later in the fight. A wingbeat while the storm is still spread across the ceiling drags the lightning lanes sideways, so the safe gap moves.

The full bout. In phase two she climbs high, wings folding tight, her dive's line and landing marked (dash past), and dives head first, glass and all. The glass cracks on the floor and the storm runs out along it both ways (jump). Weak window: she lies there, the storm leaking out of the cracked glass, before she lifts herself home.
fights.alt: A floating lady with a storm-filled glass globe for a head and storm-feather wings: the lightning inside her globe bunches toward Elfy and punches through the glass at the floor as Elfy steps aside; she lifts the crystal stopper off her head and the storm pours out across the ceiling, glowing lanes appear and lightning strikes down them while Elfy stands in the gap; then she rises, wings lifted high, the storm inside her going dark, and gives one great wingbeat that throws Elfy back across the floor, tearing feathers loose that fall and lie sizzling

realms.title: Realm 4: The Rust Orchard · Save Sparky devlog
realms.name: The Rust Orchard
realms.tagline: Blades in autumn: a wood grown through the wreck of something enormous that fell out of the sky.
realms.eyebrow: Save Sparky devlog · realm 4 · the rust orchard
realms.lede: Blades in autumn. A wood at dusk grown through the wreck of something enormous that fell out of the sky: crimson and gold trees leaning over rusted hull plates still blinking with cold teal lights, god-rays slanting through the canopy, fog at three depths, fireflies low. A catwalk bolted to the hull, a great bough and a gantry hung on chains make the room three storeys tall, and the enemies here use all of it. The leaves never stop falling: they swing down and settle in drifts, whirl in every gust, crunch up under every landing, and every blade that passes through them cuts them in two. Drawn at the game's pixel scale, with Elfy for size. Realm 1 · Realm 2 · Realm 3.

fights.name: The Harvester
fights.eyebrow: 1 · Reap, Leaf Storm, Flurry · a scythe-armed mantis-scarecrow on the boughs
fights.lede: A mantis-scarecrow built out of rust and wire: a spine of iron, long reverse-jointed legs that throw it from bough to gantry to catwalk, a harvest-festival coat in tatters flapping round it, and two arms that end in scythes, folded in front of it like a mantis praying. It has no head to speak of, only a little projector on a stalk throwing a hologram of a carved gourd's face in front of itself, scanlined, flickering, glitching from one grin to the next.
notes: The reap. Warning: on its bough it rears both scythes back high behind it, leaning away and coiling, its face snapping to a glare, while the crescent of the reap is dotted out in the air below. Then it swings: a huge, slow, dark crescent with a pale ghostly edge reaps round from the bough, hangs, and tears away from its tail in curling wisps. Every leaf it passes through is cut in two. Get out of its reach.

Leaf storm. It crouches, springs and lands on the hanging gantry, setting it swinging. Leaves spiral up round it in bands of wind and lift it off its feet; four lines reach from it to the floor; then it flings razor leaves down them, spinning and glinting, shredding the leaves they pass. Get off the floor: Elfy jumps up onto the catwalk.

Flurry and the cut. It drops onto her catwalk, the walkway sagging, and its scythes become a blur: a storm of little crescents at every angle, sparks off each. Its reach is marked along the walkway. Then it rears back once more and thrusts: a long glinting streak down the catwalk with a star at its tip, and Elfy is knocked off.
Weak window. Its face glitches out into static, the projector spitting sparks, its scythes drooping, before it springs home to the bough.

The full bout. In phase two it curls up, scythes out, the floor under the catwalk lit (get up on the catwalk), drops off the bough and comes down the room as a reaping wheel of blades. It bites into the far wall. Weak window: stuck there, its face gone to static; drop down and hit it before it tears free and springs home over Elfy (get low).
fights.alt: In an autumn wood grown through a crashed machine, a mantis-like scarecrow robot with scythe arms and a hologram pumpkin face rears back on a high branch and reaps a huge dark crescent that slices the falling leaves in two while Elfy runs out of it; it leaps to a hanging gantry, leaves spiral up round it and it flings razor leaves down four lines as Elfy jumps up onto a catwalk; it drops onto her catwalk, slashes a flurry of cuts, then a long thrust that knocks her off; its hologram face glitches into static before it springs back to its branch

fights.name: Thornwire
fights.eyebrow: 2 · Thorns, the Whip and the Snare · a spider-drone that lives upside-down
fights.lede: A spider that was a maintenance drone once: a cage of rusted ribs round a dim red core, wrapped in coils of barbed wire, and briars have grown through all of it, thorns and all. Eight legs of wire with hooked tips. Where a head should be, a bunch of camera lenses like dark berries, each catching the light, all turning together to look at you. It lives upside-down under the boughs and catwalks and comes down on its own cable.
notes: It's almost never where you can reach it. Under the bough, under the catwalk, swinging between them on its cable like a pendulum, legs drawn in, then snatching the underside of the next platform and settling with a bounce.

Thorns. Warning: it rears against the bough, its lenses ringed teal and glaring red, and the seam's path glows along the floor. It drops a cable to the floor and a seam races out from it, glowing, and hooked metal thorns punch up behind it one after another, each bigger than the last, throwing up leaves and dirt. They're too big to jump by the end: get up onto the catwalk.

The whip. From under the catwalk it creeps to the edge, and a ring of red settles on Elfy. A loop rolls down its thorned cable as it curls up over the edge, and the tip cracks where she stood with a white pop, shredding the leaves. Drop off.

The snare. The floor cracks round her in a glowing ring; cables burst up and spiral round her legs and cinch with a snap. It drops off the catwalk and scuttles in, rearing to pounce. She tears free just in time and vaults it.
Weak window. It pounces on empty floor and lands on its back, legs flailing, sparks spitting, lenses blind, until it rights itself and reels itself home on its cable.

The full bout. In phase two it creeps along the bough, its swing's arc dotted and its landing outlined (dash), and swings down on its cable to slam where Elfy stood. Its reach is ringed, then it whirls a barbed lasso at shin height (jump). Weak window: tangled in its own wire, legs flailing, lenses blind, before it reels itself home.
fights.alt: A barbed-wire spider robot overgrown with briars hangs under a branch, drops a cable to the floor and sends a seam racing along it with hooked thorns punching up behind, each bigger, so Elfy jumps up onto a catwalk; it swings across the room on its cable to the underside of her catwalk, creeps to the edge and cracks a thorned whip over the top where she stood as she drops off; cables burst from the floor and cinch round her legs while it scuttles in to pounce; she tears free and vaults it, it lands on its back flailing, then reels itself home

fights.name: The Quakewright
fights.eyebrow: 3 · Quake, Boulder, Spikes, the Fall · a digging machine that breaks the room
fights.lede: A digging machine that learned to walk and to hate. A hulking golem of rusted plate on two piston legs, hazard stripes worn to rust down its edges, a drill for one fist and a sledgehammer for the other. Its head is an excavator's cab: two amber headlamps for eyes behind a cracked windscreen, and a toothed bucket for a jaw. In its chest a plasma core beats in a steel cage, throwing a ring of light on every beat. It doesn't climb the platforms; it breaks them.
notes: The quake. Warning: it raises both fists high and rears up on its legs, its bucket jaw dropping, while the floor flashes. Then it slams down: three jolts, each harder, the room shaking, a rift tearing out along the floor glowing molten deep inside, the slabs heaving up and dropping askew, pebbles hopping, every leaf thrown into the air. The floor is death; ride it out on the catwalk.

The boulder. It drives its drill into the floor in a spray of grit, tears out a boulder and lifts it overhead in both fists while a ring settles on Elfy's catwalk. It throws: the boulder arcs over, shedding dust, and smashes into the catwalk, which buckles and swings down from its last bolts. Get off first.

Earth spikes. It punches the drill into the floor and leaves it spinning, and a glowing crack opens under Elfy, then the next place she'll be, then the next: faceted stone spikes ram up with shards at their sides, one after another, chasing her across the room.

The fall. It crouches deep and leaps onto the hanging gantry. The chains strain, sparks fly, and they snap: the golem and the gantry come down together in the biggest crash in the fight, leaves and wreckage everywhere.
Weak window. Overheated, it kneels in the wreck, steam venting, its cage doors swung open on a white-hot core spitting arcs, until it rises and the cage closes.

The full bout. In phase two it crouches deep, core flaring, its landing outlined under Elfy (dash), and leaps the whole room, driving itself into the floor. Its core flares and a ring of plasma runs out along the floor (jump). Weak window: half-buried, its cage open on the core. It tears itself out and leaps home over her (get low).
fights.alt: A huge rusted excavator golem with a drill fist and a hammer fist raises both arms and slams the floor three times, tearing a glowing rift and heaving the slabs while Elfy rides it out on a catwalk; it drills a boulder out of the floor and hurls it at her catwalk, which buckles and gives way as she drops off; it punches the floor and stone spikes ram up under her one after another as she runs; then it leaps onto the hanging gantry, the chains snap and it crashes down with it, kneeling overheated with its chest cage open on a white-hot core

fights.name: The Cutter Kites
fights.eyebrow: 4 · Ricochet, the X and the Pin · a pair of blade drones, and a wall to cling to
fights.lede: Two blade drones shaped like the seeds of a maple: a faceted pod with a single lens for an eye and one long curved wing that is a blade. They drift on the air the way the real seeds do, spinning, and then they don't drift. They're cold against the autumn, from the far side of the colour wheel: midnight-blue steel with cyan edges, one with a cyan eye, one violet. They hunt as a pair. This corner of the wreck has a sheer bulkhead for a wall, a crane hook swinging a pallet across the room, and a plate bolted high on the hull; Elfy uses the wall.
notes: Ricochet. Warning: one rises, winds back and glints, and its whole path is dotted out across the room with every bounce ringed. Then it whirls down it, a blurred disc of blade, bouncing off the floor and the hook in flashes and rings, every leaf in its path cut in two. Elfy runs to the wall, jumps onto it, clings and slides down it after it passes.

The X. Warning: they part to two corners and wind back along two lines that cross on Elfy, her spot marked. Then they dart: two strokes closing on the crossing, flashing white as they meet, a burst of cyan and violet sparks. Elfy is up the wall, clinging between the two lines, and slides down after.

The pin. One plants its blade in the plate bolted high on the hull; the other stabs into the wall. A beam flickers between them and locks: the upper storey is shut. Then the wall one drags its end down the wall, gouging sparks out of the rust, and the beam scissors down across the room; get under its high end. Then the plate one tears loose and dives at her.
Weak window. The wall one has driven itself into the rust too deep: jammed, twisting, eye flickering, while its twin circles it, until it tears free.

The full bout. In phase two they lock together into one four-bladed saw, its whole ricochet dotted out and every bounce ringed (get up on the hook), and it ricochets floor, wall, floor, shredding everything it passes, then bites into the floor and jams. Weak window: jammed, both eyes flickering, before they tear apart and rise.
fights.alt: Two maple-seed blade drones in dark blue steel: one glints and whirls down a dotted path, ricocheting off the floor and a crane hook while Elfy clings to a rusted wall and slides down it; then they part to two corners and dart along two crossing lines that flash white where they cross on the spot Elfy just left by jumping onto the wall; then one plants on a high plate and the other stabs into the wall, holding a beam of light between them, and drags its end down the wall so the beam scissors down while Elfy runs under its high end; the plate one dives and hits her; the wall one is left jammed, struggling

fights.name: The Spore Abbot
fights.eyebrow: 5 · Spores, the Beam and the Warp · a floating priest of the wreck
fights.lede: A censer that became a priest that became a toadstool. A great domed cap of indigo steel studded with cyan lamps, violet light glowing up through the gills beneath it; under the brim, in shadow, a brass monocle lens and a grille for a mouth; a moth-eaten robe of midnight velvet hanging below with no feet in it, hovering on a faint cold glow; thin jointed arms, one swinging a censer on a chain. It plants its children, it drips, it lifts you up and lets you go, and it steps from pad to pad in a column of light. Here the wall is on the right, the platforms carry teleporter pads, and the fog lies thicker.
notes: Cold against the autumn. Indigo, cyan and violet, the far side of the colour wheel from the leaves, so it never sinks into the scenery.

Spore toadstools. Warning: it winds its censer back and flings seeds, and rings mark where they'll land. Steel toadstools push up out of the floor, swell and tremble, their gills glowing brighter, then squash and puff lumpy clouds of glowing violet spores that billow up, drift and settle. Get above them: Elfy runs to the wall, jumps onto it and clings there, sliding slowly.

The warp. A column of light: it flickers, flashes white and streams up off its pad, and slams down on the high plate right beside her, painting itself back in from the top. She kicks off the wall and flips away.

Drip and the beam. It drifts over her dripping tar, a puddle of black veined with violet that bubbles. Warning: a cone of light is outlined round her. Then the tractor beam: leaves and grit tear loose and spiral up into its lens, rings of light climb, and Elfy is lifted and carried over the tar and let go into it, poisoned.
Weak window. It warps back to its pad and sags there, lamps out, its lens cracked, rings of light rising off the pad into it as it recharges.

The full bout. In phase two it drifts down close and lets its censer out on a long chain, the whole circle of its reach dotted (get up on the plate), and whirls it round itself in a great circle, then slams it into the floor; spores roll out both ways. Weak window: its chain snagged, it sags, lamps out, lens cracked.
fights.alt: A floating robot toadstool in an indigo cap and a velvet robe flings seeds from a swinging censer; steel toadstools push up from the floor, swell with glowing violet gills and puff clouds of spores while Elfy clings to a rusted wall above them; it streams up in a column of light and slams down on a high plate beside her, she kicks off the wall; it drifts over her dripping tar, then lifts her in a cone of light and carries her over the tar and drops her in, poisoned; it warps back to its pad to recharge, its lamps out

fights.name: The Gale Warden
fights.eyebrow: 6 · Sail Sweep, Leaf Tornado, Lance, Claw · the boss of the orchard
fights.lede: A knight the size of a mill. Plate of blue-black steel, a violet tabard, a cape torn into ribbons that never stops moving; for a head, a little mill tower with a conical violet cap, and on its face four sails of pale canvas on a lattice round a hub with one cyan eye. A jousting lance striped cyan in one hand, a gauntlet with three talons on the other. Everything about it is wind, and it fights like the last act of a shonen fight: every strike is a held breath, focus lines closing in on the wind-up, and then a gale and a two-tone impact frame.
