notes: Sail sweep. Anticipation the wrong way round: its sails slow, stop, and wind backwards while it leans away, and they telescope out to three times their length; the reach is ringed. Then it bows and the sails whirl through the floor in a white blur, sparking where they graze it, cutting every leaf in reach. They overshoot, spring back and retract.

Leaf tornado. It plants its feet and its sails blur; a path is marked to her catwalk. A funnel of wind writhes loose and wanders across the room, tearing up the leaves into it. It catches Elfy and carries her up a storey, spinning, and throws her onto the gantry, so the next attack can reach her.

Lance. It coils, sails locked in an X, lance drawn back, a glint at its tip, focus lines closing in; the line of the thrust is marked across her storey. She drops. It leaps, after-images trailing, and a spear of wind runs the whole width of the room, with an impact frame and the gantry swinging on its chains. It lands hard.
The claw. It rears its gauntlet high and back, three arcs marked over her; then the swipe over the top and down, three violet crescents that hang and tear away, and this one catches her.

Weak window. All that wind has a cost: leaves stream into its sails and choke them. They judder and grind to a stop, the hub sparking and smoking, and it drops to one knee, lance planted, head bowed, eye guttering. Then it shakes them out in a burst of leaves and rises.

The full bout. In phase two, storm form: it lifts off on its sails, a corridor at head height lit across the room (crouch), and flies the room, sails a blur. It wheels at the wall and comes down lance first; a ring of wind bursts out along the floor (jump). Weak window: spent, kneeling on its planted lance, sails stopped. It leaps home over Elfy (get low).
fights.alt: A huge armoured knight with a windmill for a head winds its sails backwards and leans away as they telescope out, then bows and whirls them through the floor while Elfy escapes onto a catwalk; its sails blur and blow a leaf tornado that wanders across the room, catches her and flings her up onto a hanging gantry; it coils with its lance drawn back, leaps, and thrusts a spear of wind down the whole storey as she drops off; it rears a three-taloned gauntlet and swipes three violet crescents that knock her back; then its sails choke on leaves and grind to a stop and it kneels, lance planted, until it shakes them out and rises

realms.title: Realm 5: The Sanctum Above the Clouds · Save Sparky devlog
realms.name: The Sanctum Above the Clouds
realms.tagline: A white-marble cathedral afloat on a sea of cloud, with poison and dark magic where the prayers should be.
realms.h1: Realm 5: The Sanctum Above the Clouds
realms.eyebrow: Save Sparky devlog · realm 5 · the sanctum above the clouds
realms.lede: Poison and dark magic in a holy place. A cathedral of white marble and gold leaf afloat on a sea of cloud at sunrise: colonnades on cloud banks, a great rose window, golden balance scales and bells on chains. Something has got into it. Violet-black rot creeps across the marble from the right, the clouds there curdle into tar, the gold tarnishes, and the feathers drifting down are white on the holy side and black on the other. Poison is magenta, dark magic black with violet rims, warnings white for blades and magenta for poison, and the biggest hits land on a gold-on-black impact frame. Drawn at the game's pixel scale, with Elfy for size. Realm 1 · Realm 2 · Realm 3 · Realm 4.

fights.name: Ser Aurelian, the Half-Gilt Duelist
fights.eyebrow: 1 · Iaido, the Scales, Flurry and the X · a duelist half-eaten by rot
fights.lede: A holy fencer, still beautiful down one side: polished gold plate and a white plume. The other side has gone violet-black and wet, and the rapier in that hand drips magenta venom that eats holes in the marble. He fights like a duelist out of a tournament arc: he sheathes, goes still, and is already past you; the cut arrives after the click of the scabbard. He fights round the great balance scales of the Sanctum.
notes: Iaido. Warning: he slides the rapier home, sinks low, hand on the hilt, his visor glaring white; the line of the cut is marked across the floor, focus lines close in, and everything goes still, even the falling feathers hang in the air. Get off the floor: Elfy jumps onto a pan of the scales. Then one black frame, and he is on the other side of the room, frozen in his follow-through. Only when he straightens and the scabbard clicks does the cut open behind him, a long gold streak splitting into crescents, sparks off the scales' post, every feather in its path cut in two.

The scales. He leaps onto the other pan. His weight drops it and throws her up off hers, high into the air, while he crouches on the pan below, his lunge marked up to her. He thrusts: a glint at the point, a bundle of streaks, an after-image. She flips over it onto the ledge. With his weight gone the scales rock back and settle.

Flurry. He follows her onto the ledge and the rapier becomes a storm of little crescents, every one flicking venom; the drops eat smoking pits with glowing magenta rims into the marble, and they stay.
The X. Warning: he raises the blade high, an X marked over her. The cut: two great strokes crossing on her, a comic impact star, and she's thrown off the ledge, poisoned, magenta veins climbing her.

Weak window. The rot isn't his: his arm seizes and fights him, rot tendrils writhing out of the shoulder, and the sword slips and sticks in the ledge. He kneels clutching the arm while the gold side burns against it. Then he masters it, takes up the sword, and leaps back to his mark.
fights.alt: A knight in gold plate on one side and violet-black rot on the other sheathes his rapier and goes still while a line is marked across the floor; Elfy jumps onto a pan of a great golden balance scale; in one black frame he is past her, and the cut opens behind him at the click of his scabbard; he leaps onto the other pan, which drops and throws her up into the air, and lunges up after her with his rapier, but she flips over it onto a high ledge; he follows and slashes a flurry of crescents, flicking venom that eats smoking holes into the marble, then cuts a great X that knocks her off, poisoned; then his rotten arm seizes, he drops his sword and kneels, fighting it, before he takes up the sword and leaps back to his mark

fights.name: The Plague Cherubs
fights.eyebrow: 2 · Gas Net, Popper, Sickle Swarm · three working together
fights.lede: Three fat little cherubs on moth-eaten wings, faces hidden behind cracked porcelain gas masks with round lenses glowing magenta, each trailing a hose to a tarnished censer that never stops smoking, each with a tiny sickle. They work as a team and they think it's hilarious. The clouds they gas curdle into tar and sink, so the floor of the fight keeps going away.
notes: Gas net. Warning: they fly to the corners of a triangle round her and the lines between them are marked. Then a sheet of magenta gas is stretched between them, swirling, and the triangle closes. Elfy jumps out to the next cloud. The net collapses onto the cloud she left: it curdles to tar from the top down, drips, and sinks to the floor, where it lies as a bubbling pool.

Popper. One flies in close and swells up like a puffball, trembling, lenses wide, gas leaking from it; its blast is ringed. It pops: a white flash, a burst of lumpy poison cloud, and it shoots off spinning like a let-go balloon. Her cloud curdles under her.

Sickle swarm. They line up overhead, bouncing with giggles; three dive lines are marked, one after another. Each rears up and dives, a ring of blade spinning round it, cutting feathers; Elfy runs under them, the first two miss, the third catches her: a comic impact star, an impact frame, poisoned.

Weak window. They bounce off the floor into each other and land in a heap, masks askew, lenses spinning, stars circling, burping little puffs of gas. Then they flutter up and home, and the clouds grow back in a glitter of gold.
fights.alt: Three cherubs in porcelain gas masks fly to the corners of a triangle around Elfy on a high cloud and stretch a sheet of magenta gas between them, closing it like a net; she jumps out to another cloud and the gas collapses onto the cloud she left, which curdles into black tar and sinks to the floor; one cherub flies to her and swells up like a puffball, trembling, then pops in a burst of poison cloud and flies off spinning like a let-go balloon, while her cloud curdles under her and she drops to the floor; the three line up giggling and dive at her one after another with blades spinning round them, and the third catches her, poisoned; they bounce off into a dizzy heap with stars circling, then flutter home as the clouds grow back

fights.name: The Tolling Hollow
fights.eyebrow: 3 · Toll, Grave Bell · a set piece that hunts you
fights.lede: A great cracked bronze bell, green with verdigris, hanging from a cloud gone to rot. Its clapper is one bloodshot violet eye on a tendon, and it watches you through the cracks. The smaller bells hanging round it are the only footing left once the glass is gone, and every toll sets them swinging.
notes: Toll. Warning: it rears back, slowly, its eye burning through the cracks; rings of sound are marked spreading from it and the glass ledges flicker. Elfy jumps onto a small bell. Then it swings and the eye-clapper strikes the rim: a comic star on the bronze, a gold-and-black impact frame, three rings of sound that shatter both ledges into tumbling shards of coloured glass. Every bell in the room swings with it, Elfy riding hers.
Tar. It rocks, settling, tar dripping off its lip and hissing in little pools on the marble.

Grave bell. Warning: the chain snaps link by link, sparks at each; its outline is marked on the floor round her, focus lines closing in. It drops: a slam that throws the clouds aside, an impact frame. Then it tolls three times with her inside, jumping on the floor, light blasting out through its cracks.

Weak window. Black tendrils reach down from the rot cloud, wrap the crown and haul it back up. It rang itself dizzy: it hangs there wobbling, stars round its crown, its eye lolled out of its mouth on its tendon, spinning and drooling tar. Elfy staggers out, seeing stars too. Then the glass flies back up off the floor into the ledges.
fights.alt: A huge cracked bronze bell hangs from a black cloud, an eye peering out through a crack; it rears back slowly while rings of sound are marked, and Elfy jumps from a stained-glass ledge onto a small swinging bell; it swings and its eye-clapper strikes the rim, and rings of sound shatter both stained-glass ledges into tumbling shards while the small bells swing; it rocks, dripping tar; then its chain snaps link by link, its outline is marked around Elfy on the floor, and it drops over her and tolls three times with her inside, light blasting from its cracks; black tendrils from the cloud haul it back up, and she staggers out dizzy while its eye lolls out of its mouth on its tendon, spinning; then the glass flies back up into the ledges

fights.name: Acolyte Nil and the Stitched Seraph
fights.eyebrow: 4 · Hex Sigil, Grasping Hands, Uppercut, Hammer Smash, the Chain · a puppeteer and its puppet
fights.lede: A tiny hooded child-priest with a candle for a staff and two pale eyes in the hood, and a hulking angel stitched together out of broken statues with violet thread: a ribcage for a chest with a violet heart beating in it, a serene cracked face, one stone wing, one great gilded fist off some other saint. Nil works it like a marionette from a high ledge, writes hex sigils in the air with the candle, and calls hands up out of the floor. Hit Nil and the threads snap.
notes: A puppet. At rest the Seraph hangs slack on its threads, head lolling, fists swinging. When Nil takes up the threads it straightens. Every move it makes, Nil's hands make first.

Hex sigil and the hands. Warning: Nil writes in the air with the candle, the pen point sparking, and the sigil burns itself into the floor round her, ring, star, runes, until it flares white. She jumps, but a pool opens and shadow arms burst out of it, catch her and drag her down, clenched round her. She's cursed: a dark stain climbing her, violet smoke, a glitching skull over her head.

Uppercut. The Seraph stomps over and crouches, its gilded fist low behind it; the blow is marked up through her, focus lines closing in. The hands let go as it hits: a comic impact star, a gold-on-black impact frame, and she's launched, flipping onto the ledge.

Hammer smash and the chain. Both fists go up overhead, slowly, a dome marked over the ledge; she goes up onto a cloud and the fists come down: a dome of force, the end of the ledge broken off, rubble bouncing, the marble cracked. Nil writes another sigil; a chain shoots out, locks onto her cloud and yanks it out from under her.

Weak window. She drops, slides between the Seraph's legs, leaps onto Nil's ledge and dashes straight through Nil. The threads snap and whip away, and the Seraph falls apart: head, cage, wing and limbs tumbling into a heap of statue. Nil sits dazed, hood knocked back, candle out. Then Nil relights it, the threads shoot out, and the pieces fly back together across the room.
fights.alt: A hooded child-priest on a high ledge writes a burning violet sigil in the air with a candle staff and it burns into the floor around Elfy; she jumps, but shadow arms burst from a pool and drag her down and pin her, cursed, while a hulking angel golem stitched from broken statues stomps over on violet threads and winds up a gilded fist; it uppercuts her into the air and she flips onto a marble ledge; it raises both fists overhead and smashes the ledge in a dome of force as she jumps up onto a cloud; the priest writes another sigil, a glowing chain shoots out and locks onto her cloud and yanks it out from under her; she drops, slides between the golem's legs, leaps onto the priest's ledge and dashes through the priest; the threads snap and the golem falls apart into a heap of statue pieces while the priest sits dazed; then the priest relights the candle and the pieces fly back together

fights.name: The Molting Saint
fights.eyebrow: 5 · Black Halo, Molt, Eclipse, False Smite · corrupted holy magic
fights.lede: A weeping angel statue floating before the rose window, hands over her face. Her stone wings are molting, feathers gone loose and some gone black, and her halo has eclipsed into a black ring with a pearl corona. A column of light beside her lifts Elfy up to the ledges, while it lasts.
notes: Black halo. Warning: she uncovers her face, blank sockets streaked with rot, and lifts the halo off her head, arching back; its path is marked as a great loop round the room. She throws it: spinning, trailing, it scythes round at shin height, cutting every feather it passes, and comes back to her hand. Elfy jumps it.

Molt. She folds her wings tight round herself, focus lines closing in, then bursts them open with an impact frame. Stone feathers fly off, brake and rock in the air, then turn to point, lines marked to where they'll strike, and stab down together as darts. They root in the marble as violet thorns, and stay. Elfy rides the column of light up to the ledge.
Eclipse. A black moon slides across the rose window, a pearl corona round it, and the light goes out of the room. The column of light turns into a downdraft.

False smite. A glint marks her on the ledge and a dotted line falls from the sky. She drops off the ledge, into the downdraft, and it slams her down into the thorns, cursed. Then a bolt of black light splits the ledge where she stood: black core, white rim, an inverted star, cracks glowing violet.

Weak window. The eclipse passes and she sinks, wings drooping, hands to her face again, and weeps real light: tears of gold running between her fingers and falling, her halo flickering gold. Then the thorns crumble.
fights.alt: A weeping angel statue lifts her black halo while its path is marked round the room, and throws it; it scythes round at shin height cutting feathers and Elfy jumps it before it returns to her hand; she folds her wings tight, then bursts them open, and stone feathers fly off, brake and rock, turn to point, and stab down as darts that root as violet thorns while Elfy rides a column of light up to a ledge; a black moon slides over the rose window and the column turns into a downdraft; a glint marks Elfy on the ledge, she drops into the downdraft and it slams her down into the thorns, cursed, as a bolt of black light splits the ledge; then the eclipse passes and the statue sinks and weeps tears of real light, her halo flickering gold

fights.name: The Eclipse Heart
fights.eyebrow: 6 · Tendrils, Soul Drain, Necro Skulls, the Shatter, the Burst · the boss of the Sanctum
fights.lede: The source of the rot. Where the rose window broke, a black sphere hangs in a tilted banded disk of light, debris spiralling into it, a pale rim round it and a pearl corona, and in front of it floats a cracked marble mask, serene, its eyeholes glowing violet. Halfway through, the mask shatters and it powers up.
notes: Tendrils. Bladed tendrils coil out of it, barbed, a white-edged crescent at each tip; the line of each lash is marked across a storey. The first lashes along the floor: the loop runs down the length of the whip and the tip cracks with a white pop and a ring of air. Elfy goes up onto a cloud. The second lashes at cloud height, and she drops under it.
Soul drain. A funnel is outlined to her, then it drinks: pale wisps stream out of her, spiralling down its throat. She runs, and slides toward it anyway, until she dashes free and the funnel snaps.

Necro skulls. Four spectral skulls circle it, smoke trailing, eyes lighting one by one; each one's landing spot is ringed. They fire one after another: she runs, jumps, runs again, and the fourth catches her on the cloud. Cursed.

The shatter. The mask trembles, light leaking from its cracks, focus lines closing in, the room darkening. Then it shatters: an impact frame, a violet aura flaring off the bottom of the whole screen and in spikes round the sphere, the corona streaming huge, and both clouds torn loose and pulled into orbit round it.

The burst and the weak window. The core pulses and contracts. Then it bursts: a black star across a violet-white flash, three shockwaves, the clouds flung home, Elfy blown back. It hangs collapsed, small, smoking, its white core showing through the cracks, until the shards of the mask fly back together.
fights.alt: A black sphere in a banded disk of light hangs in the broken rose window behind a cracked marble mask; bladed tendrils coil out of it and lash along the floor, the tip cracking, while Elfy jumps onto a cloud, then lash at cloud height as she drops under; a funnel drinks pale wisps out of her and she runs but slides toward it until she tears free; four spectral skulls circle it and fire one after another at marked spots, and the fourth catches her, cursed; the mask trembles and shatters in an impact frame, a violet aura flares off the whole screen and the clouds are torn loose into orbit around it; the core contracts and bursts in a black star across a violet-white flash that flings the clouds home and blows her back; then it hangs collapsed and smoking, its white core showing through cracks, until the mask flies back together

realms.title: Realm 6: The Orrery at the End of the Sun · Save Sparky devlog
realms.name: The Orrery at the End of the Sun
realms.tagline: An observatory orbiting a dying sun, where gravity is optional and so is the clock.
realms.h1: Realm 6: The Orrery at the End of the Sun
realms.eyebrow: Save Sparky devlog · realm 6 · the orrery at the end of the sun
realms.lede: Gravity, time, space and starlight. An abandoned observatory of brass and black glass orbiting a dying red giant: the dome cracked open to space, the bloated crimson sun filling the window, and behind everything a gigantic orrery turning, nested rings and model planets. These are bosses in the hard style: three or four moves each with a distinct tell, a feint that punishes reacting too early, a second phase that changes the room, and punish windows sized to how committed each attack is. The setting is warm, so the enemies are lunar silver and magenta plasma; blades warn in white, projectiles in magenta, gravity in gold. Drawn at the game's pixel scale, with Elfy for size. Realm 1 · Realm 2 · Realm 3 · Realm 4 · Realm 5.

fights.name: The Lamplighter
fights.eyebrow: 1 · Lantern Swing, Kindle, Snuff, Stomp, the Moth Double · solar fire in the dark
fights.lede: A stilt-legged automaton three times Elfy's height that wanders the station relighting dead stars: a long black coat in tatters, legs jointed like a heron's, and for a head a brass lantern with a captured sun-ember in it, dust moths always circling. It carries a lamplighter's pole with a burning wick. Its signature is the snuff: it shuts its lantern and the whole room goes out, and you fight it on glints alone.
notes: Lantern swing. It rears the burning pole back over its head, leaning away, focus lines closing in, the arc of the swing marked. Then it swings, and the wick leaves a burning arc hanging in the air, dripping embers, that lingers after the swing has passed.

Kindle. It spits embers from the lantern onto the ledges and the floor; each lies there pulsing, ringed. They ignite one after another in pillars of solar fire, a line chasing her across the room, and she has to go up.

Snuff. It shuts the lantern and the room goes black. All that's left is its moths, its two eye-slits, and the glint at the end of its pole. A glint: nothing comes. That's the feint; reacting to it is what it wants. Then the real glint, she drops, and a thrust runs the whole high ledge in the dark. The lantern opens with a flash.
Stomp. It rises on its stilts, the floor marked, then slams down: a wave runs along the floor both ways and the ceiling is shaken loose, debris falling.
The moth double (phase two). The moths swarm into a burning copy of it, beside it, that does everything it does half a beat late. It swings; she jumps it; she lands into the copy's swing. Scorched.
Weak window. All that fire overheats it: it folds down on its stilts and the lantern swings open to vent steam and embers, the white core exposed.
fights.alt: A towering stilt-legged automaton with a lantern for a head rears a burning pole back while its arc is marked and Elfy jumps onto a ledge; it swings and leaves a burning arc in the air; it spits embers onto the ledges and floor that pulse and then ignite one after another in pillars of solar fire chasing her up to the high ledge; it shuts its lantern and the room goes black except for its moths and eye-slits; a glint at the end of its pole, but nothing comes; a second glint, she drops, and a thrust runs across the high ledge in the dark; the lantern opens with a flash; it rises on its stilts and stomps, sending a wave along the floor and shaking debris from the ceiling as she jumps to a ledge; its moths swarm into a burning copy of it that swings half a beat behind it, and the copy catches her, scorched; then it overheats, folds down on its stilts, and its lantern swings open to vent

fights.name: The Ouroboros Engine
fights.eyebrow: 2 · Track Dash, Derail, Tail Battery, the Split · a serpent on rails
fights.lede: A colossal serpent-train of brass carriages that rides the great orrery ring as its rail: a silver locomotive with a skull for a cowcatcher and two magenta lamps for eyes, carriages with little alien passengers glowing at the windows, a missile battery for a tail. Break the right coupling and it splits in two.
notes: Track dash. Anticipation the train way: it slows almost to a stop, wheels straining, steam pouring, while chevrons run round the ring and the floor is marked. Then it whips round the ring in a blur, sparks off the rail, leaves it at the bottom and tears off down the floor and out of the room.

Derail. Its leap is marked in gold, and it comes back through open space, flying over her; gravity bends toward its body as it passes, gold arrows pulled toward it, and Elfy floats up off her ledge. It lands back on the ring with an impact frame.

Tail battery. It coils to a stop. A reticle locks on her; the tail's pods blink; six homing missiles, smoke trails curling. She leads them: off the ledge, under the ring, up the other side, and they come down into the floor and into each other.

Weak window and the split (phase two). Overheated, it stalls, its couplings glowing, one white-hot. She dashes into it and it breaks: the two halves race round the ring in opposite directions, the rear half's battery now its face, firing at her. Then they meet at the top and couple again with a clang.
fights.alt: A serpent-train of brass carriages loops a great ring rail; it slows almost to a stop, straining, while chevrons run round the ring and the floor is marked, and Elfy jumps onto a ledge; it whips round the ring throwing sparks, leaves it at the bottom and tears off down the floor; its leap through open space is marked in gold and it comes flying back over her, gravity bending toward it so she floats, and lands back on the ring with a clang; it coils to a stop and its tail fires homing missiles at her, reticles on her, and she leads them into the floor; overheated, its couplings glow white; she dashes into the hottest one and it breaks, and the two halves race round the ring in opposite directions, the rear half firing its battery at her, until they meet at the top and couple again

fights.name: Madame Perigee, the Astrolabe Witch
fights.eyebrow: 3 · Time Stop, Rewind, the Feint, the Gravity Hour · time and gravity
fights.lede: A woman's shape made of nested brass and silver rings turning like an astrolabe, round a porcelain face with painted gold lashes and a hairline crack; a magenta clockwork heart ticking inside the rings of her skirt; a clock hand for a wand. She doesn't hit hard. She takes your timing away.
notes: Time stop. She raises the wand and fires a fan of clock hands at Elfy, and in the same breath stops time: an impact frame, the world drained grey, the hands hanging in the air with their paths marked ahead of them. Elfy keeps her colour and gets one move: a dash through the gap. Time resumes and the hands drive into the floor where she was.

Rewind. A clock ring is traced round her as she climbs to the ledge. Then she's dragged back two seconds along her own grey afterimages, back to where she stood, and the great pendulum was already swinging for that spot. The dodge she made doesn't count; she has to make another, over its blade.

The feint. She winds up another time stop exactly as before: focus lines, rings spinning up, arms raised. Elfy braces. Nothing. The witch laughs, her porcelain head rattling. Reacting to the wind-up is what loses.

The gravity hour (phase two). A great clock face fills the window. As its hand sweeps up, gold arrows mark which way down is about to be, and gravity flips: everything loose falls up and Elfy lands on the ceiling, running it upside down while needles come up at her. The hand sweeps down, she falls back through a beam marked across the room, and she's time-locked: frozen mid-air, drained grey inside a clock face.

Weak window. She overwinds: her rings spin to a scream, throwing sparks, until her mainspring snaps out of her chest and uncoils. She sags to the floor ticking wrong. Then she rewinds herself, back up into the air.
fights.alt: A floating figure of turning brass rings with a porcelain face fires a fan of clock-hand needles at Elfy, then stops time: the world goes grey and the needles hang in the air with their paths marked, and Elfy dashes through a gap before they drive into the floor; Elfy climbs to a ledge and a clock ring is traced around her, then she is dragged back two seconds along her own grey afterimages to where she stood, and a huge pendulum blade swings through that spot, so she jumps it; the witch winds up another time stop and doesn't cast it, laughing; a great clock face fills the window and as its hand points up gravity flips and Elfy falls to the ceiling and runs along it upside down dodging needles; the hand swings down, she falls through a beam and is frozen in a clock face, time-locked; then the witch overwinds, her rings screaming, and her mainspring snaps out of her chest as she sags to the floor

fights.name: Pilot Quib and the Bulwark
fights.eyebrow: 4 · Gravity Mines, the Nuke, Eject · a duo: a tiny pilot and a huge machine
fights.lede: A tiny squid-like alien in a fishbowl helmet steering a hulking siege walker: reverse-jointed legs, a slab of silver hull with magenta running lights, shield pylons on its shoulders, a mortar for an arm and a mine launcher on its back. The walker shields the pilot; the pilot does the thinking. When the walker overheats, Quib ejects and fights on foot.
notes: Gravity mines. A hex shield dome goes up over the walker, and the launcher on its back lobs mines; each landing spot is ringed first. They lie pulsing, then each one pulls: gold rings collapsing inward, grit dragged in, Elfy dragged along her ledge. They pop in a chain, and she jumps clear between them.

The nuke. The mortar rises, charging, Quib hauling on a lever, focus lines. The blast radius is marked over almost the whole room; the one gap in it is the walker's own shield. She has to run toward it and crouch under the dome. The shell climbs slowly, falls slowly, and the room goes white: a mushroom of fire, three shockwaves, debris bouncing off the dome as it flashes.

Eject (phase two). The walker overheats, its hull glowing red and venting; the cockpit pops and Quib ejects on a little jetpack. Now there are two: the empty walker keeps firing bolts at her, and Quib, quick and cowardly, hops up onto a ledge to zap her with a raygun from behind it.

Weak window. She dashes up and catches him: a comic star and his fishbowl cracks, water spraying, and he flails on his back, seeing stars. Then he tapes the crack with an X of tape, jets back into the cockpit, and the walker reboots.
fights.alt: A siege walker with a tiny squid pilot in a fishbowl helmet raises a hexagonal shield dome and lobs gravity mines whose landing spots are ringed; they pull Elfy toward them before popping in a chain as she jumps clear; its mortar rises, charging, and the blast radius is marked over the whole room except the walker's own dome, so she runs in close and crouches under it; the shell climbs and falls and the room goes white in a mushroom blast, debris bouncing off the dome; overheated and glowing red, the walker's cockpit pops and the pilot ejects on a jetpack; the empty walker keeps shooting bolts while the pilot hops onto a ledge and zaps at her with a raygun; she dashes up and catches him and his fishbowl cracks, water spraying, and he flails on his back; then he tapes the crack and jets back into the cockpit and the walker reboots

fights.name: The Four Phases
fights.eyebrow: 5 · One, Two, Four: Tides, Eclipse, New Moon, Grief · four sisters in synergy
fights.lede: Four alien knight sisters named for the moon, each a different body. New: a shadow-cloaked blink striker, a dark disc for a helm ringed in silver. Crescent: a lithe dancer with two sickles and a crescent horn sweeping off her helm. Half: a squat tank with a half-moon mirror for a shield and a hammer. Full: a tall sniper, her helm a glowing full moon, a lunar lance-rifle. They bow. They fight one at a time, then two, then all four, and their best moves need each other.
notes: One. They bow, all four, at their stations. Crescent drops from the high ledge, winds up, sickles out, and spins across the floor as a ring of blades; her line is marked. Elfy jumps her.

Two: Tides. Crescent spins on the high ledge and the air bends: wind lines dragging toward Half, and Elfy, running against it, slides toward Half anyway while the hammer goes up, slowly, the floor marked. She jumps out of the pull; the slam sends shockwaves both ways under her.

Four: Eclipse and New Moon. Half tilts the half-moon mirror up; Full charges, focus lines, the path of the beam marked from her lens to the mirror and on to Elfy. The beam reflects off the mirror at her and she jumps it. Then New dissolves into motes, a dark mark appears behind Elfy, and New is there, and stabs.

Grief. Crescent drops in again, winding up, and Elfy dashes through her first: an impact frame, and Crescent breaks up into motes and drifts away. The other three kneel. Then they rise in a magenta grief-rage aura, eyes white, and roar. Each has something new: New blinks three times down the floor, slashing; Full fires three beams that sweep the high ledge; Half leaps and slams and spikes run down the floor.

Weak window. Their formation has a gap: when they swap stations, one of them is alone for a moment. New, caught between blinks, takes the hit and kneels. Then Crescent reforms from the motes, and they return to their stations and bow.
fights.alt: Four alien knight sisters at their stations bow; Crescent drops from the high ledge and spins across the floor, and Elfy jumps her; then Crescent spins on the high ledge and the air drags Elfy toward Half, whose hammer rises, and Elfy jumps out of the pull before the slam sends shockwaves both ways; Full charges a beam marked off Half's tilted mirror shield, and the beam reflects at Elfy, who jumps it; New dissolves, a dark mark appears behind Elfy and New reappears there and stabs her; Crescent drops in again and Elfy dashes through her first, and Crescent breaks up into motes; the other three kneel, then rise in a magenta grief-rage aura with a roar; New blinks three times down the floor slashing, Full fires three beams across the high ledge, and Half leaps and slams with spikes running down the floor while Elfy dodges from ledge to ledge; as they swap stations New is caught alone and takes a hit and kneels; then Crescent reforms from the motes and they bow

fights.name: The Unborn Sun
fights.eyebrow: 6 · Flares, the Waking, Orbit, the Countdown, Collapse · the final boss of the orrery
fights.lede: At the heart of the orrery, in a cage of magnetic rings: a fetal angel of white-hot plasma, curled, its wings folded, a cord of fire running from it to the cage, its heart beating through the whole room. The dying star's own heart. Three phases: the cage, the waking, the end.
notes: Phase one: the flares. Gold field lines arc out of the cage's poles down to the floor. One after another a line brightens, dots running down it, its splash spot ringed; then a ball of fire runs down it and bursts on the floor in pillars of solar fire. They come in a rhythm, left and right; read the line, not the fire. One catches her: scorched.

Phase two: the waking. The rings strain, buckle and crack, sparks flying, focus lines closing in; the child stirs. The cage breaks with an impact frame, its rings flung across the room. Then, in one black-and-white frame, it opens its eyes for the first time: huge, white, tiny black pupils. Gravity turns toward it: gold arrows pointing in, grit spiralling in, and every platform falls into orbit round it, Elfy riding hers.
Phase three: the countdown. Twelve ticks round it go out one by one, and it burns brighter. The platforms glow red-hot and burn away into embers one by one, until only hers is left.

Collapse. Its desperation move: an implosion. The edges of the room go dark, everything streaks inward, her platform is dragged toward it. The pull is the only way in: she rides it straight to the core and strikes. A comic star, a white impact frame, three shockwaves.
Weak window. It curls up small, dims and cracks, smoking, its eyes closing. Then the platforms and the cage re-form out of the embers.
fights.alt: A curled fetal angel of white-hot plasma floats in a cage of magnetic brass rings, its heart beating; gold field lines arc from the cage to the floor, and one after another a line brightens and fire runs down it to splash on the floor in a rhythm while Elfy dodges between them, until one scorches her and she climbs onto a floating platform; the rings strain and crack and the cage breaks, and the child opens its huge white eyes; gravity turns toward it and every platform falls into orbit around it with Elfy riding hers; twelve ticks around it go out one by one as the platforms glow red and burn away until only hers is left; then it collapses inward, the room going dark and everything streaking toward it, and Elfy rides the pull straight in and strikes the core; it curls, dims and cracks, smoking, until the platforms and the cage re-form out of the embers

realms.title: Realm 7: Noon at the Ossuary Chapel · Save Sparky devlog
realms.name: Noon at the Ossuary Chapel
realms.tagline: Gothic, undead, poisoned, and dressed for a wedding at high noon.
realms.h1: Realm 7: Noon at the Ossuary Chapel
realms.eyebrow: Save Sparky devlog · realm 7 · noon at the ossuary chapel
realms.lede: Gothic, undead and poisoned, and dressed for a wedding at high noon. A chapel built inside an ossuary: every wall is bones, skulls stacked in niches and femurs laid in herringbone, all of it painted in sorbet pastels, blush and lilac and butter and cream. Sun pours through a rose window in long shafts full of dust; a lilac runner runs down the aisle between chequered marble; there are garlands, a candle in every niche, petals hanging in the air, and three balconies piped like the tiers of a cake. The elements are new: bone, mirror-light, wine, wax, ink and sugar. Poison is violet and magenta; blades warn in white. Realm 6: the orrery.

fights.name: The Pallbearers
fights.eyebrow: 1 · Procession, Toss, Skull Volley, the Tower Ram, Lid Slam · bone, four as one
fights.lede: Four skeletons in lilac morning coats, boutonnieres and veiled top hats, carrying a blush-lacquered coffin with gold handles on their shoulders, always in step. Something inside the coffin is poisoned and breathing. They are one enemy with four bodies, and the coffin they carry is a platform: you can ride it, and they will use that.
notes: Always in step. Four skulls bob together under their top hats, coat-tails swinging, the coffin rocking on their shoulders; their eye sockets glow violet.

The procession. They lower their heads and the lane lights up the length of the room; then they charge, marble chips flying. Standing in the lane is death, but the coffin is the safe place: Elfy jumps onto it and rides it to the wall. The stop is a hit-stop and a flash.

The toss. They crouch, and a violet fence marks where the poison will fall; Elfy double-jumps off the coffin for the high tier. They heave it straight up: it flips end over end, the lid swings open and violet poison pours out of it in a curtain, and they catch it again.

The skull volley. Each pops its own head off and lobs it at the high tier, one after another, each landing ringed first. The skulls bounce, rattle and come rolling home to their necks. Elfy leaves the tier for the right-hand one.

The tower ram (phase two). They climb onto each other's shoulders, two towers holding the coffin high as a battering ram, its line drawn at tier height. Elfy drops to the floor under it; the ram sweeps the tier she was on.
Lid slam. The towers topple forward, the landing outlined and the floor turning violet, and bring the coffin down lid first. A wave of poison gas rolls out both ways: jump it.

Weak window. They fall apart into a heap of bones round the overturned coffin, four skulls rolling on the marble, eyes dimmed, stars over them. Elfy cuts them three times; then they put themselves back together, lift the coffin, and she has to jump all four of them to get home.
fights.alt: In a pastel ossuary wedding chapel four skeleton pallbearers carry a pink coffin; they charge the room and Elfy jumps onto the coffin and rides it; they toss the coffin, which flips with its lid open pouring violet poison, while Elfy leaps to the high balcony; they pop their skulls off and lob them at her; they climb onto each other's shoulders and ram the coffin at balcony height; they topple and slam it lid first, a wave of violet gas rolling both ways; they fall apart into a heap of bones and Elfy cuts them

fights.name: Lady Gloss
fights.eyebrow: 2 · Lunge, Noon Beam, Shatter, Every Mirror · mirror-light
fights.lede: A vampire countess who exists only in mirrors. In the room she is a gap where a woman should be; in the glass she is all there: a black-violet ballgown with a white lace hem, a corset laced in blush, a wired lace collar standing up behind her head, silver hair piled high with a ribbon, red eyes, a black lace fan. Two gilt mirrors hang on the walls and a cheval glass stands under the high tier, and she moves between them.
notes: Only in the glass. Each mirror shows a dim silver room and a slanting highlight; she appears in one, fanning herself, and is simply not there in the room. When she comes out, she is glassy, glints trailing her, and goes back in with a splash of glitter.

The lunge. She appears in the right-hand mirror and her path is dotted: out, down across the floor, up into the left-hand mirror. She comes out fan first, horizontal, and flies it. Dash under the low point.

The noon beam. She raises her fan in the cheval glass and catches the sun from the rose window; the beam's zigzag is dotted from mirror to mirror and down to the floor. Then a bar of white light burns along it, flaring at each bounce, scorching the marble where it lands. Stand where it doesn't go.

The shatter. She presses her hands to the glass and it cracks into a spider; rings mark the floor. Then the cheval glass bursts and the shards fly up in a fan, turning, and fall on their rings. The glass mends itself after.

Every mirror (phase two). She is in all three mirrors at once, and three of her lunge at Elfy together. Only one casts a shadow on the floor: the real one. The other two are glass; dash through them and they burst into glitter. Jump the real one as it skids along the floor and dives for the cheval glass.

Weak window. She dives back into the glass too fast and sticks in it to the waist, her skirts kicking in the room, the glass cracked round her; Elfy cuts her three times before the mirror swallows her back.
fights.alt: In the pastel ossuary chapel a vampire countess visible only in mirrors lunges out of one wall mirror down across the room and into another while Elfy dashes under her; she bounces a beam of sunlight from mirror to mirror in a zigzag while Elfy crouches clear of it; she shatters her cheval glass and shards rain on ringed spots; in phase two she appears in all three mirrors and three of her lunge at once, only the real one with a shadow; Elfy dashes through the two fakes, jumps the real one, which gets stuck half inside the cheval glass, and cuts her

fights.name: The Sommelier
fights.eyebrow: 3 · The Pour, the Cork, the Corkscrew, the Wine Serpent · wine
fights.lede: An undead wine steward with impeccable manners: bony legs in black trousers and polished shoes, a long white apron, a silver tray of coupes on one hand and a corkscrew for the other. His body is a cut-glass decanter full of poisoned wine, sloshing whenever he moves, violet bubbles rising in it; his skull is its stopper, with a monocle on a chain and a waxed moustache.
notes: The pour. He bows, the floor ahead of him goes wine-dark, then he tips himself over like a decanter and pours: a stream from his neck, and the floor floods from his feet to the far wall with poisoned wine, bubbling violet. It soaks away after. Be up.

The cork. He shakes himself up, the wine foaming inside him, and the cork's whole ricochet is dotted with every bounce ringed: ceiling, the left tier, the wall, home. Then his head pops off with a bang and a geyser of froth and ricochets along it. Drop off the tier before it gets there.
The corkscrew. His corkscrew arm winds up, whirring, its line drawn at chest height across the room; then he lunges, the arm stretching the length of the floor in a shower of sparks. Get high.

The wine serpent (phase two). The decanter cracks and the wine leaves him: a ribbon of poisoned wine with his skull for a head, swimming the room in a figure of eight, its loop shown faintly. It turns on the high tier, its landing outlined; drop off, and it dives past into the floor and bursts up as three geysers where the rings were.
Weak window. The empty decanter slumps on its legs, dry and cracked, the monocle dangling, a drip at the neck. Elfy cuts him three times; then the wine runs back up into him and he re-corks himself.
fights.alt: In the pastel ossuary chapel an undead sommelier whose body is a decanter of wine bows and pours himself across the floor while Elfy waits on a balcony; he shakes himself and his skull pops off like a cork and ricochets round the room; he thrusts a corkscrew arm across the room while Elfy is up on the high tier; his decanter cracks and the wine leaves him as a serpent with his skull for a head, loops the room and dives, splashing into three geysers; the empty decanter slumps and Elfy cuts him

fights.name: Taper, the Waxwork Saint
fights.eyebrow: 4 · Drips, the Flood, the Wick Chain, the Spray, the Waxwork · wax
fights.lede: A saint made of a hundred melted altar candles: a tapering column of layered wax in cream, blush and lilac, robes carved into it and running, drips forever creeping down it; a melted saint's face with hollow eyes that weep wax; and for a crown, a ring of lit wicks. It holds up a candelabra. Everything it does leaves wax behind, and the wax is part of the fight.
notes: Drips. It tilts its crown and rings mark the floor; drips of hot wax fly from the wicks and land on them, and harden there into lumps.

The flood. It sinks into itself, melting at the base, and the floor glows: hot in orange, the safe islands outlined in white. Then molten wax runs across the whole floor, glowing and steaming, except the islands, which stand proud. It cools from the islands outward into hardened cream.
The wick chain. It raises the candelabra and a row of wicks sparks along the floor; then they light one after another, pillars of candle-flame chasing across the room. Go up.

The spray (phase two). Its crown flares to twice the height and it fills its cheeks; a cone is drawn from its mouth over the high tier. Drop and crouch: a fan of molten wax sprays over where Elfy was.
The waxwork (after the pixelfx summon-rise). The spilt wax stands up as a waxwork of Elfy, her own shape in cream, its lane lit; it lunges at her. Jump it, and it sags back into a puddle.
Weak window. It sprayed so hard it blew its own crown out: the wicks gutter and smoke, it slumps on itself, the wax cracking. Elfy cuts it three times; then a spark, and the crown relights.
fights.alt: In the pastel ossuary chapel a towering saint made of melted candles with a crown of lit wicks tilts its head and wax drips fall on ringed spots and harden into lumps; it melts at the base and floods the floor with glowing hot wax that cools into islands where Elfy stands; it raises its candelabra and pillars of candle-flame light along the floor one after another while Elfy climbs to the high tier; its crown flares and it sprays a fan of molten wax over the high tier; the spilt wax stands up as a waxwork of Elfy that lunges at her; it has blown its own crown out and slumps smoking while Elfy cuts it

fights.name: The Scrivener
fights.eyebrow: 5 · Dripping Words, Grasping Hands, the Hex, the Blotted Sun · ink and shadow
fights.lede: The registrar of the dead, who signs every guest in: a plague doctor in a long ink-black coat bleeding at the hem, a capelet with bone buttons, a wide hat; a bone mask with round lilac lenses whose long beak is a quill, its nib always wet; a scroll of names unrolled to the floor. It fights by writing, and everything it writes comes true.
notes: Dripping words. It nods its head, scribbling, and a line writes itself across the air under the ceiling, dotted and flickering, the floor under it marked. Then the ink lets go: a curtain of drops falls from the line and spatters the floor. Get out from under; the left balcony is a roof.

Grasping hands (after the pixelfx grasping-hands). It flicks three blots onto the floor, each ringed. A hand of ink grasps up out of each, one after another, fingers curling, lit violet. Be up on the balcony.
The hex (after the pixelfx hex-sigil). It points, and a hex writes itself on the balcony under Elfy: a ring of turning runes and a star in it. Get off; it goes up in a column of ink.

The blotted sun (phase two) (after the pixelfx eclipse and shadow tendrils). It flings ink over the rose window and the room goes black; only Elfy, its lenses and its shadow are lit. The shadow comes off the floor: a long arm of shadow sweeps the length of the floor (a line flickers first; jump), then again at head height (crouch). The light comes back.
Weak window. It slips in its own ink and goes down on its back, its quill-beak stuck in the floor, stars over it. Elfy cuts it three times; then it pulls its beak free and dusts itself off.
fights.alt: In the pastel ossuary chapel a plague doctor whose beak is a quill writes a line in the air which drips a curtain of ink while Elfy shelters under the left balcony; it flicks three ink blots onto the floor and a hand of ink grasps up out of each one after another while Elfy is on the balcony; it writes a hex sigil under her and she drops off before it goes up in a column of ink; it blots out the rose window and in the dark its shadow sweeps along the floor and then at head height while Elfy jumps and crouches; it slips in its own ink and lands on its back with its beak stuck in the floor while Elfy cuts it

fights.name: The Widow Cake
fights.eyebrow: 6 · Bouquet, Poppers, the Hop, the Wheel, the Crawl · sugar · the bride
fights.lede: The bride, and the last of the wedding. A three-tier wedding cake in blush and cream, piped scallops and running icing, sugar skulls round every tier, a violet ribbon, a lit candle every few inches; and for its topper the bride herself: a skeleton in a lace bodice under a veil that pours down the cake to the floor, a tiara, a bouquet of poison-violet roses. The fight takes the cake apart tier by tier until she comes for you herself.
notes: The bouquet toss (after the pixelfx charmed status). She raises the bouquet and its landing is ringed; she throws it in a high arc, and where it lands it bursts into a haze of poison and floating hearts that lingers. It is very pretty and you must not walk into it.

The poppers (after the pixelfx confetti). Her candles flare and the floor in front of the cake is fenced off; then every candle goes off like a party popper, three fans of sugar sprinkles arcing onto the floor and confetti everywhere. Be up on a balcony.
The hop. The whole cake squats, its landing outlined, then jumps and comes down with a crash of icing and rings along the floor.
The wheel (phase two). The bottom tier cracks off; its lane is lit at wheel height. It rolls the length of the room, spokes of ribbon turning; double jump it.

The crawl (phase three). The bride drags herself out of the cake, drops to the floor and crawls at Elfy on her bony hands, veil dragging, the lane lit. She rears, the lunge's arc dotted, and throws herself; Elfy flips over her.
Weak window. She lands face down in her own veil, confetti everywhere, stars over her. Elfy cuts her three times; then she crawls home and the cake makes itself whole again.
fights.alt: In the pastel ossuary chapel a three-tier wedding cake with a skeleton bride on top throws her bouquet onto a ringed spot where it leaves a haze of poison and hearts; her candles fire like party poppers, three fans of sugar sprinkles and confetti arcing onto the floor while Elfy waits on a balcony; the whole cake hops and slams down with a crash of icing; its bottom tier cracks off and rolls across the room as a wheel and Elfy double-jumps it; the bride drags herself out of the cake, crawls at Elfy on her hands with her veil dragging, rears and lunges; Elfy flips over her and she lands face down in her veil and confetti, seeing stars, while Elfy cuts her; she crawls home and the cake makes itself whole

realms.title: Realm 8: The Last Bathhouse · Save Sparky devlog
realms.name: The Last Bathhouse
realms.tagline: A bathhouse kept by its ghosts: mint spirits, lime acid, and a very polite kappa.
realms.eyebrow: Save Sparky devlog · realm 8 · the last bathhouse
realms.lede: A public bathhouse long closed, at midnight, still being kept by its ghosts. Dark cedar pillars and beams, indigo-and-cream tiles, a great faded mural of a mountain over waves on the back wall, red paper lanterns, steam always rolling; and the soaking pool sunk in the middle of the floor is full of glowing lime acid, an arched footbridge over it, wooden lofts either side. Mint is spectral, lime is acid, and both are kept well clear of Elfy's own saturated green: mint leans cyan and pale, lime leans yellow. Realm 7: the ossuary chapel.

fights.name: The Attendant
fights.eyebrow: 1 · Bucket Splash, Behind You, Soul Drain, the Sheet · spectral
fights.lede: The ghost who still keeps the bathhouse: a tall woman in a white yukata patterned in indigo, a wide sash, long black hair down over her face with one mint eye showing through, a towel over her shoulder and a cedar bucket bound in copper. She has no feet; below the hem she trails off into mist. She is mint-washed and see-through, and you can't hurt mist.
notes: Bucket splash. She drifts to the pool's edge and dips her bucket in the acid; three rings mark the floor. She swings and throws, three gobs of glowing acid in arcs, and they land on the rings and lie there fizzing and steaming. Get up on the loft.

Behind you (after the pixelfx blink-out and blink-in). She sinks through the floor. A mint ripple spreads on the loft right behind Elfy, and the towel's line is drawn across it. She rises out of the boards and snaps her towel across the whole loft. Drop off.

Soul drain (after the pixelfx soul-drain). She reaches, and a tether of mint runs from her hand to Elfy: Elfy is pulled toward her, and her colour drains out of her and runs along the tether, until she dashes far enough to snap it: the bridge.

The sheet (phase two). She comes up at her station and snaps her towel out into a sheet of spectral cloth that sweeps the footbridge: first at head height (crouch), then at the ankles (jump), each line flickering first.
Weak window. She overdoes it and turns solid: opaque, colour in her yukata, her eye gone dark, slumped and dazed. Solid things can be hit. Elfy cuts her three times before she fades back to mist.
fights.alt: In a midnight bathhouse with a pool of glowing lime acid a mint ghost attendant dips her bucket in the acid and throws it onto three ringed spots while Elfy jumps onto a loft; she sinks through the floor and rises behind Elfy on the loft and snaps her towel across it as Elfy drops off; a tether of mint drains the colour out of Elfy until she dashes onto the footbridge and it snaps; her towel becomes a sheet of spectral cloth that sweeps the bridge at head height and then at the ankles while Elfy crouches and jumps; she turns solid and dazed and Elfy cuts her

fights.name: The Soak
fights.eyebrow: 2 · Spit, Belly Flop, Slimelets, the Whirlpool · acid
fights.lede: The bath water gone bad. A great wobbling blob of lime acid that lives in the pool and is as big as the pool, with two bubble eyes and a wide dripping mouth; everything that ever fell in is still floating inside it, a bath stool, a bucket, a sandal, some bones, and at its heart a rubber duck. The duck is what it really is.
notes: The spit. It swells, its mouth opening wide, and three rings mark the floor; then it spits three gobs of acid in arcs that splash on the rings and fizz. Get up on the loft.

The belly flop. It rears up out of the pool, stretching tall and leaning, its landing outlined on the floor; then it flops onto the floor in a crash of acid, wobbling flat, rings and spray both ways, steam coming off it, and slides back into the pool.

Slimelets (after the pixelfx slime). It shudders and splits into three little slimes that hop out after Elfy, each landing ringed first: one onto her loft (drop off it), one onto the floor where she lands (jump for the bridge), one off to the far side. They squash and wobble, then hop home and merge.

The whirlpool (phase two) (after the pixelfx black-hole). It sinks, and the pool turns into a spinning vortex: everything on the floor and the bridge is dragged toward its centre. Elfy has to run against the pull off the bridge to the far floor. A column is outlined, and it erupts in a geyser of acid and comes down.

Weak window. It collapses into a thin crust over the pool, and its heart pops out: the rubber duck, landing dazed on the floor. Elfy hits the duck three times; it dives home and the Soak swells back up.
fights.alt: In the midnight bathhouse a huge blob of lime acid slime rises from the pool and spits three gobs of acid onto ringed spots while Elfy jumps onto a loft; it rears up and belly-flops onto the floor in a wave of acid and slides home; it splits into three slimelets that hop after Elfy onto the loft, the floor and the far side while she jumps from loft to floor to footbridge; it turns the pool into a whirlpool pulling everything in while Elfy runs against it off the bridge; it erupts in a column of acid and collapses thin, and a dazed rubber duck pops out of it onto the floor where Elfy hits it

fights.name: Ozeki Kappa
fights.eyebrow: 3 · Shiko, the Salt, the Tachiai, the Tsuppari, the Bow · acid, sumo
fights.lede: A river imp who is also a champion wrestler: river-stone blue skin, a tortoise shell on its back, a yellow beak, a red mawashi with a fringe of cords, and on top of its head, in a ring of dark hair, the dish every kappa has, full to the brim with lime acid from the pool. It is enormously strong. It is also, like every kappa, terribly polite.
notes: Shiko. It slaps its belly, then lifts one leg high, leaning, the floor flickering; it stomps, and a crest runs the length of the floorboards (splashing through the pool on the way). Then the other leg. Jump each one.
The salt. It reaches into its mawashi and flings a fistful of purifying salt in a glittering arc onto four rings. Get onto the bridge.

The tachiai. It settles into its stance, fists down, the charge's arc and landing marked. Then it charges and leaps the whole pool, right through where the bridge is; double jump over it. It lands on the far side and skids into the wall.

The tsuppari (phase two). Angry, steam puffing from its ears, it fires open-palm thrusts along the bridge: white handprints of force, low, high, low, high, each line flickering first. Jump, crouch, jump, crouch.

The bow, and the weak window. Elfy bows to it. It cannot help itself: it bows back, deeply, and the acid pours out of its dish. A kappa with an empty dish has no strength: it slumps to its knees, eyes spinning. Elfy hits it three times; it trudges to the pool, scoops its dish full, and leaps home.
fights.alt: In the midnight bathhouse a sumo-wrestling kappa with a dish of glowing acid on its head lifts each leg high and stomps, sending crests along the floorboards that Elfy jumps; it flings a fistful of salt onto ringed spots while Elfy moves onto the footbridge; it settles into its stance and charges, leaping the pool right over the bridge as Elfy double-jumps it; angry, it fires open-palm thrusts along the bridge, low and high, while Elfy jumps and crouches; Elfy bows, it bows back and spills its dish of acid, and slumps dizzy while Elfy hits it; it refills its dish from the pool and leaps home

fights.name: Chōchin
fights.eyebrow: 4 · The Lick, the Roost, Lights Out, the Dive · spectral fire
fights.lede: One of the bathhouse's own paper lanterns, old enough to have come alive: a ribbed cylinder of yellowed paper between black lacquered rims, split open into a grinning mouth full of paper teeth, one huge eye, a long lolling tongue; and inside it, where the candle should be, a cold mint ghost-fire glowing through the paper. Bats roost in it.
notes: The lick. Its mouth splits wide, the paper stretching, and a pink line flickers at head height; then its tongue shoots the length of the room. Crouch.
The roost (after the pixelfx bat). Its mouth gapes and the bats come out in a stream, flapping along the floor in a wave, mint eyes glinting. Get up on the loft.

Lights out (after the pixelfx wisp). It puffs up and blows the other lanterns out; the room goes black but for its own fire, Elfy and four ghost-fires circling it. They peel off one after another and dive at ringed spots: the loft, the floor, the bridge. Get off the loft. The lights come back.

The dive (phase two). It catches fire, mint flames licking up its paper, and rises to the ceiling over Elfy; a mark locks on under it, its eye looking straight down. Then it drops like a stone. Dash. It bounces up, locks on again, and drops again.

Weak window. The second dive tears it: it lies crumpled on the floor, the bamboo frame showing through the rips, tongue out, eye spinning. Elfy hits it three times; then it puffs itself out and floats back up.
fights.alt: In the midnight bathhouse a living paper lantern with one eye and a split grin shoots its tongue across the room at head height while Elfy crouches; it lets a stream of bats out along the floor while Elfy climbs to a loft; it blows the other lanterns out and the room goes dark while mint ghost-fires circle it and dive at ringed spots; it catches fire and rises to the ceiling, locks on and dive-bombs twice while Elfy dashes out from under each mark; the second dive tears its paper and it lies crumpled while Elfy hits it

fights.name: The Drain Wyrm
fights.eyebrow: 5 · Lunge, Under the Boards, Stone Spit, the Tail, the Knot · acid
fights.lede: What lives down the drain: a long serpent of lime acid ringed darker, a pale belly, a flat wedge of a head with big wobbling googly eyes whose pupils rattle round loose, catfish whiskers, and the bath's rubber drain plug hanging from a ring through its nose on its little chain. Its spit sets into stone.
notes: The lunge. The pool churns, then a serpent rears out of it, its lunge drawn to the bridge. It strikes the bridge; get off.

Under the boards. It dives and swims under the floorboards: they bulge along its path, and its burst is marked where Elfy stands. Get up on the loft; it bursts up through the boards in a spray of splinters.
Stone spit (after the pixelfx petrified status). It rears and spits three gobs that go grey as they fall and set into stone pillars where they land: things to stand on, for a while.
The tail (phase two). Its tail comes out of the pool and sweeps the far side: first the loft (drop onto the pillar), then the floor (stay up on it).

The knot, and the weak window. It rears and lunges at Elfy on her pillar; she jumps over its head, and it lunges so hard it ties itself in a knot, its head flopped on the floor, eyes rattling. Elfy hits it three times; it unties itself and slithers back down the drain, and the pillars crumble.
fights.alt: In the midnight bathhouse an acid serpent with googly eyes and a drain plug on its nose rears out of the pool and lunges at the footbridge as Elfy jumps off; it swims under the floorboards, which bulge along its path, and bursts up where she stood while she climbs a loft; it spits acid that sets into three stone pillars; its tail sweeps the loft and Elfy drops onto a pillar, then the floor while she stays on it; it lunges at her, she jumps over its head and it ties itself in a knot, eyes rattling, while she hits it

fights.name: The Proprietress
fights.eyebrow: 6 · Abacus, the Doorways, Closing Time, the Beam · spectral · the owner
fights.lede: The owner, who never left. An enormous mint ghost of a bathhouse matron rising out of the acid behind the footbridge: a dark kimono patterned with waves and a red sash, her hair in a great bun stuck with gold pins and a comb, a round powdered face, rouged cheeks, a beauty mark, and the most expressive eyebrows in the building; they do most of her talking. She keeps the accounts on an abacus and closes up with a hand bell.
notes: The beads. A sly look, one brow up; rings mark the bridge and the floors. She flicks a row of beads off her abacus in arcs, and they land and bounce. Get off the bridge.

The doorways (after the pixelfx portal). Her brows come down. The left doorway's curtain ripples open on mint light and a mark lands on the loft under it; a giant ghost hand reaches out of the doorway and slams the loft. Then the right doorway: a hand reaches out and sweeps the floor flat, its line flickering first. Drop, then jump for the bridge.

Closing time (phase two) (after the pixelfx time-stop). Her brows fly up; she rings her bell and flings acid at the room. Time stops: everything drains to grey under a great clock face, the drops hang in the air, and a dotted line runs from each to the ring where it will land. Only Elfy can move. Get somewhere no line ends. Time starts again and the drops land.

The beam (phase three) (after the pixelfx disintegrate). She takes a breath that puffs her cheeks out, eyes squeezed shut; the whole floor flickers. Then she breathes a column of mint light that takes the floorboards apart as it sweeps the room, the boards piecing themselves back together behind it; at the far end it rises up the wall over the loft. Be up, then drop behind it.

Weak window. Out of breath, she deflates like a paper balloon to the size of Elfy's head and flops onto the bridge, eyes spinning. Elfy hits her three times; then she puffs herself back up, and smiles.
fights.alt: In the midnight bathhouse an enormous mint ghost matron rises behind the footbridge and flicks abacus beads onto ringed spots; the doorway curtains ripple open as portals and a giant ghost hand slams the left loft, then another reaches out and sweeps the floor while Elfy dodges onto the bridge; she rings a closing bell and flings acid, and time stops: the room goes grey under a clock face while the drops hang in the air with lines to where they will land and Elfy moves to the far loft; time starts and they land; she puffs her cheeks and breathes a beam that takes the floorboards apart as it sweeps the room and rises up the far wall; out of breath she deflates to a tiny paper-balloon ghost and flops on the bridge while Elfy hits her

realms.title: Realm 9: The Midas Night Bazaar · Save Sparky devlog
realms.name: The Midas Night Bazaar
realms.tagline: Molten gold, rubber-hose cartoons, a scale that tips, and bosses who act with their eyebrows.
realms.eyebrow: Save Sparky devlog · realm 9 · the midas night bazaar
realms.lede: A night market in a canyon, under a colossal golden hand whose fingers pour molten gold in two glowing falls. Striped stalls, paper lanterns, gold in the cracks of the cobbles, stall-roof ledges either side and, in the middle, a great merchant's scale whose pans tilt with whatever lands on them. Gold here is molten and stretchy: it sags, pulls, snaps and drips. The shopkeepers are goofy hybrids from mixed-up lore, drawn like 1930s rubber-hose cartoons: noodle limbs, white gloves, pie-cut eyes and big brows that do all the acting, with hand-lettered sound words on the big hits. Realm 8: the last bathhouse.

fights.name: Lucky Bull
fights.eyebrow: 1 · the Beckon, the Charge, the Money Rain, the Slip · molten gold, a lucky cat
fights.lede: A minotaur who runs a lucky-charm stall, crossed with the beckoning cat: a big brown bull in a red happi coat trimmed in gold, rubber-hose arms in white gloves, one paw forever raised and waving you in. Gold bells on his horns, a gold ring through his nose, a gold tooth in his grin, and the bushiest brows in the bazaar.
notes: The beckon. His paw waves, his brows go sly, and on each wave a spinning coin arcs out onto a ring. One lands on the left pan of the scale, which tips with the weight. Elfy gets up onto the stall roof.
The charge. Warning: he paws the cobbles, brows slammed down, snorting dust, and the lane lights up. Then he runs the length of the bazaar into the stall under Elfy. CLANG.

Stuck. His horns go into the molten gold of the stall; he tugs, eyes worried, teeth gritted, and the gold stretches and sags and thins until it snaps, BOING, and flings him back across the market, squashing as he lands.

The money rain (phase two). He shakes his head, the horn bells ring, and coins fall out of the dark onto rings one after another, ledge, floor, pan, floor. Keep moving: down off the roof and up onto the scale.

The slip, and the weak window. He strolls over to gloat, steps on one of his own coins, and goes over flat on his back, hooves in the air, stars circling. Elfy hits him three times; he dusts himself off and waves you back in.
fights.alt: In the golden night bazaar a minotaur shopkeeper in a red coat beckons with a gloved paw, and each wave flings a coin onto a ringed spot, one landing on the scale and tipping it, while Elfy jumps onto a stall roof; he paws the ground and charges into the stall, and his horns get stuck in molten gold that stretches until it snaps and flings him back across the market; he shakes his belled horns and coins rain down onto rings one after another while Elfy hops down and onto the scale; he strolls over to gloat, slips on a coin and lands flat on his back seeing stars while Elfy hits him three times; he gets up and goes back to his stall

fights.name: Anubis, Live!
fights.eyebrow: 2 · the Wheel, the Weighing, the Bonus Round, the Showcase, Bankrupt · gold, a game show
fights.lede: The weigher of hearts, hosting a game show: a black jackal head with tall gold-lined ears and a striped headdress, gold kohl wings round his pie-cut eyes and gold brows over them, a lapis tuxedo, a red bow tie, a broad gold collar, and a gold microphone always at his snout. His wheel picks the round. His scale decides who is guilty.
notes: Spin the wheel. His free arm is rubber hose: it stretches the length of the market to flick the wheel, which ticks round, slows, and stops with the heart wedge under the pointer.

The weighing. He tosses a heart onto one pan and lets a feather drift onto the other; the heart is heavier, so the scale tips, and the heavy half of the floor lights up in outlined ankh columns. Get to the light side.
WRONG! The buzzer; the columns fill solid gold and slam down. Then the bonus round: he stretches out, moves the heart to the other pan, and the other half is guilty. Run back.

The showcase (phase two). He spins the wheel so hard it shakes on its stand, the floor lane flickers, and it pops off, BOING, drops to the cobbles and rolls the bazaar wall to wall, BONK, and back. Stand on the raised pan; Elfy's weight softens the tilt.

Bankrupt, the weak window. One more spin, just for him. Black wedge. His jaw drops, his ears droop, his collar falls off, and he sits down on his roof and cries. Elfy jumps up and hits him three times; he rewinds the wheel onto its stand and straightens his tie.
fights.alt: In the golden night bazaar a jackal-headed game-show host on a stall roof stretches his rubber-hose arm across the market to spin a prize wheel, which stops on a heart; he throws a heart onto one pan of the great scale and a feather onto the other, the scale tips, the heavy half of the floor is outlined in columns, and Elfy runs to the other side before gold columns of judgment slam down; he moves the heart to the other pan and Elfy runs back; he spins the wheel so hard it pops off its stand and rolls wall to wall while Elfy stands on a pan of the scale; he spins it once more for himself, it lands on bankrupt, and he sits down crying while Elfy jumps onto his roof and hits him three times; he rewinds the wheel onto its stand

fights.name: The Sphinxrechaun
fights.eyebrow: 3 · the Riddle, the Geysers, the Rainbow, the Lucky Coin · gold, a pot of it
fights.lede: A sphinx crossed with a leprechaun: a tawny lion's body lying along a stall roof like a temple statue, a little round rosy face in a huge ginger beard-and-mane, ginger brows like hedges, a tall plum top hat with a gold buckle, and a clay pipe. He guards three pots of gold with a riddle, and breathes rainbows with the green left out (Elfy has it).
notes: The riddle. He raises a paw, brows sly, and his speech bubble shows a cyan gem. Three pots of gold stand on the floor, each with a colored band. The answer is the cyan one.
The geysers. Warning: the two wrong pots rattle under outlined columns. Then FOOSH: molten gold shoots out of them to the sky and pours back in strands. Stand by the right pot.

The rainbow. He puffs his cheeks, the arch is outlined, then he breathes a real rainbow (red, orange, gold, cyan, blue, violet; no green) whose foot sweeps the whole floor in sparks. Jump it as it passes.

The lucky coin (phase two). He flips his coin on his paw, misses, and his face falls. MY COIN! He leaps off his roof and gallops after it the length of the bazaar, straight through anything in the way. Get up on the scale, then onto his empty roof.

Stuck, the weak window. The coin rolls into his biggest pot; he dives in after it and sticks head-first, legs kicking, tail wagging, the pot rattling. Elfy hits him three times; POP, out he comes with the coin and bounds home trailing a rainbow.
fights.alt: In the golden night bazaar a lion-bodied leprechaun lying on a stall roof shows a cyan gem in a speech bubble; of three pots of gold on the floor the two without a cyan band shake under outlined columns and then geyser molten gold while Elfy stands by the cyan one; he puffs his cheeks and breathes a rainbow arch whose foot sweeps the floor, and Elfy jumps it; flipping his lucky coin he drops it, and chases it the length of the bazaar while Elfy hops onto the scale and his roof; the coin rolls into his biggest pot, he dives in after it and is stuck head-first with his legs kicking while Elfy hits him three times; he pops out with his coin and bounds home on a rainbow

fights.name: Ninefold Brunhilde
fights.eyebrow: 4 · the Lash, the Aria, the Dive, the Whirl, the Tangle · molten-gold braids, opera
fights.lede: A nine-tailed fox crossed with an opera Valkyrie: a white-and-orange fox face, pie eyes with long lashes and the most dramatic brows in the bazaar, a silver winged helmet with her ears poking through, a silver breastplate, a red skirt, a round gold shield and a spear. Her nine tails are braids of molten gold, and they stretch as far as she likes.
notes: The lash. Three braids at a time, each path dashed first: three along the floor (jump), three at head height (crouch), three stabbing down onto rings on the stall, the pan and the floor. The braids stretch and thin as they reach and spring back.

The aria. Brows up to her helmet, eyes closed, mouth an O: LA-LA-LAAA. Rings of song spread out from her, each with one gap, and the gap is marked first: stand in it, then jump into it, then get up on the stall into it.
The dive (phase two). HO-JO-TO-HO! She raises her spear, her lane flickers, and she dives spear-first into the cobbles, BAM, landing on her feet.
The whirl. The circle round her is outlined, then nine braids spin out round her one and a half turns. Stay on the stall, outside it.

The tangle, the weak window. She pulls them in, and nine braids tangle: tied up in her own gold in a great bow, she topples, brows furious, lips pouting. Elfy hits her three times; POP, she bursts free in a shower of glints and sings herself home.
fights.alt: In the golden night bazaar a fox Valkyrie hovers over the right stall with nine tails of braided molten gold; three braids lash along the floor and Elfy jumps, three lash at head height and Elfy crouches, three stab down onto ringed spots; she sings, and rings of song spread from her mouth each with one gap, aimed at Elfy standing, then jumping, then up on the left stall; she cries out and dives spear-first into the cobbles, then whirls her nine braids round her in a circle; pulling them in, they tangle and tie her up in a gold bow, and she topples while Elfy hits her three times; she bursts free and sings herself home

fights.name: El Dorado
fights.eyebrow: 5 · the Serenade, the Zapateado, the Sombrero, the Word · cast gold, a mariachi
fights.lede: A golem crossed with a mariachi: a great block of a man cast in gold, in a black charro suit with gold buttons down the trousers, a big red bow tie, a huge black sombrero, a moustache with curled ends, carved brows, and a guitarrón across his belly. A golem lives by the word written on his brow, EMET, truth. Rub out the E and it reads MET, and he stops.
notes: The serenade. He sways and sings, and every strum lands on the beat: a gold note head arcs out of the guitarrón onto a ring, four beats, the last one where Elfy was standing. Step off it.

The zapateado. Brows down, teeth gritted, he lifts a boot high (the floor lane flickers) and stamps on his roof: the planks bounce and a crest of molten gold runs the length of the cobbles. Three stamps, the last an OLE. Jump each crest.
The sombrero (phase two). AY-AY-AY! He grips the brim, and the hat's whole flight is dashed out first: out at head height (crouch), round, back along the floor (jump), and up.

The word, the weak window. The sombrero comes home edge-first into his brow, BONK, and smudges the E. MET: a golem without his word stops. Eyes crossed out, he goes stiff and topples off his roof face-down, THOOM. Elfy hits him three times; he rubs the E back on with a gloved thumb and hops home.
fights.alt: In the golden night bazaar a gold golem in a mariachi suit on a stall roof strums a guitarrón, and on each beat a gold note arcs onto a ringed spot while Elfy steps off the last one; he stamps on his roof three times and crests of molten gold run along the floor, and Elfy jumps each; he cries out and throws his sombrero, which flies out at head height while Elfy crouches and back along the floor while Elfy jumps, and comes home into his brow, smudging the E of the word EMET; reading MET he goes stiff and topples face-down onto the cobbles while Elfy hits him three times; he rubs the E back on and hops home

fights.name: The Midas Jinn
fights.eyebrow: 6 · More Gold, Bigger, Shinier · the Midas touch, three wishes
fights.lede: King Midas crossed with a genie, the bazaar's last act: a big blue jinn rising on a smoke tail out of a gold lamp, in a gold vest and armbands, pointed ears with gold hoops, a crown-turban with a ruby, a beard of molten gold that drips, pie eyes and enormous black brows. Everything he touches turns to gold. He grants himself three wishes, one a phase.
notes: Wish one: MORE GOLD. His rubber-hose arm stretches across the bazaar and a great glove comes down on each outlined spot, SPLANG: the left stall, the left pan, a stretch of the floor. Each turns to molten gold, dripping and glowing, and stays dangerous until it cools. Keep off what he has touched.

Wish two: BIGGER. His hands swell to the size of stalls and sweep in from both edges of the bazaar to clap, CLAP, along lanes dashed edge to edge first: low (jump), high (crouch), then tall (get up on the pan, now cool).

Wish three: SHINIER (the weak window). He smugly touches his own chest, and the gold spreads out from his fingertips over his whole body until he is a statue of himself, eyes wide, brows up. KLANK. Elfy jumps onto his stall; each hit cracks the gold, and the third shatters the shell, CRACK.
