The lamp. Blue again and seeing stars, he goes back into his lamp, POOF; it rattles a while, and he rises out of it with three fresh wishes.
fights.alt: In the golden night bazaar a blue genie rises out of a gold lamp on the right stall; wishing for more gold, his rubber-hose arm stretches out and his giant glove slams down on the left stall, the left pan of the scale and a stretch of floor, each outlined first, gilding each into molten gold, while Elfy hops down and runs right; wishing for bigger hands, giant gloves sweep in from both edges and clap along dashed lanes, low while Elfy jumps, high while she crouches, and tall while she stands on the pan; wishing to be shinier, he touches his own chest and the gold spreads over him until he is a statue, and Elfy jumps onto his stall and hits him three times until the gold shell cracks and shatters; dizzy, he poofs back into his rattling lamp and rises again

realms.title: Realm 10: The Psi-Tower Rooftop · Save Sparky devlog
realms.name: The Psi-Tower Rooftop
realms.tagline: Sunset, floating slabs, and eight psychic kids who monologue mid-fight.
realms.eyebrow: Save Sparky devlog · realm 10 · the psi-tower rooftop
realms.lede: The roof of a skyscraper academy at sunset, where the city's psychic kids come to settle things. A striped retro sun sinking behind a neon skyline, a water tower, a VS billboard, a painted helipad; and three slabs of the roof torn up and held in the air by somebody's telekinesis, bobbing in a violet glow. These eight are Elfy's size, which makes them fast: shonen psychics with chunky boots, big shiny eyes and a pose for everything, who talk while they fight. Their words pop up over their heads when they laugh or leer, along with the menace marks, anger veins and sweat drops. Every attack still shows itself first (a dashed outline is a warning), but the windows are short. Realm 9: the Midas night bazaar.

fights.name: Zip Zephyr
fights.eyebrow: 1 · the Blink, the Afterimages, the Time Out · teleport, speed
fights.lede: A teleporting speedster: spiky navy hair, cyan goggles pushed up, a white racing suit, red boots and a red scarf twice as long as she is. She blinks. A dashed outline of her appears where she is about to be, and a beat later she is there, kicking. She is also, for all that, not very fit.
notes: The blink. ZIP: she is gone in a spray of sparks, and her dashed outline appears where she is going. TOO SLOW! Beside you, in a flying kick (jump over her). UP HERE! Above you, a dive kick into the spot (dash away). BEHIND YOU~ A high kick through the air (crouch). Each outline gets about a third of a second.
The point. She lands, points, and says HMPH! AMATEUR., menace marks drifting up beside her.

The scarf boomerang. She blinks to the far side: OVER HERE~ CATCH! Its whole flight is dashed while she winds up: out at head height (crouch), back low along the floor (jump). After the boomerang-throwing bosses of the research notes.

The wind-blade ring. She blinks up into the air and throws out a ring of eight blades, every ray dashed first: stand in a gap. The second ring is turned half a step, so a blade comes right down your gap: jump into the next one. After the reappear-and-ring pattern.

Afterimages (phase two). She splits into smears that rip across the whole roof down lanes that flicker first, each with an arrow for its direction: low (jump), mid (crouch), then both at once (get up on a slab).

Time out, the weak window. She blinks back in, hands on her knees: HAH... HAH... Then she sits down on the helipad, tongue out, sweating. TIME OUT... Elfy hits her three times. NO FAIR!! and she blinks home.
fights.alt: On a rooftop at sunset a girl in a white racing suit and a long red scarf blinks across the roof: a dashed outline appears beside Elfy and she arrives in a flying kick as Elfy jumps over her; an outline appears above and she dive-kicks the spot as Elfy dashes clear; an outline appears behind and she flies through in a high kick as Elfy crouches; she points and says amateur; then smears of her rip across the roof along flickering lanes, low and mid and then both at once, while Elfy jumps, crouches and gets up on a floating slab; she blinks back in completely out of breath and sits down, and Elfy hits her three times; she shouts no fair and blinks home

fights.name: Gigawatt Gail
fights.eyebrow: 2 · Pellets, the Charged Shot, the Wall Kick, the Giga Buster · electrokinesis, an arm cannon
fights.lede: An arm-cannon kid: an orange helmet with a lightning-bolt fin, a magenta bob, gold eyes, a fang, a navy suit and a buster where her right hand should be. Pellets, a charged shot, a wall kick, and one shot she charges for far too long.
notes: Pellets. READY? GO! PEW PEW PEW: three quick shots straight down a lane at head height that flickers first. Get up on a slab.
The charged shot. KIIIN: sparks spiral into her muzzle, she squats into it, brows down (EAT THIS!), and her aim line is drawn to the slab you are standing on. Drop off it before the BOOM.
The wall kick. She dashes to the wall, kicks off it onto the far slab and scatters three shots onto rings on the floor. Stand in the gap.

The staggered volley. TRY THIS! She drops to the floor and fires three shots at three heights, one at a time, each lane flickering first: low (jump), high (crouch), low (jump). After the staggered belly-spike volleys in the research.

The bounce shots. BOUNCY BOUNCY! Each shot's hops are dashed first: one in big hops that sail just over your head (crouch), then one in little hops along the floor (jump). After the rebound-stone pattern.

The giga buster (phase two). FULL POWER!! HEH HEH HEH... She charges for a long two seconds, trembling, grit lifting off the roof, menace marks rising, and the beam's whole box is outlined: everything below the middle slab. Climb to the top. GIGA BUSTER!! The beam fills the roof and the recoil drives her back to the wall.
PFFT, the weak window. The cannon backfires. Sooty, hair blown into an afro, coughing smoke: ...COUGH. Elfy hits her three times. OKAY OKAY! THAT WAS A WARM-UP!
fights.alt: On the sunset rooftop a girl with an arm cannon fires three pellets down a flickering lane while Elfy hops onto a floating slab; she charges a shot with a rising whine, its aim line drawn to Elfy's slab, and Elfy drops off before it blows the slab's edge; she dashes to the wall, kicks up onto the far slab and scatters three shots onto rings while Elfy stands in the gap; she charges at full power with menace marks rising, the beam's whole box outlined, while Elfy climbs to the highest slab; the giga buster fills the roof and drives her back to the wall, then backfires, leaving her sooty with an afro, and Elfy hits her three times; she says that was a warm-up

fights.name: Ronin Rewind
fights.eyebrow: 3 · the Combo, the Plunge, the Rewind, Too Far · chronokinesis, a saber
fights.lede: A saber kid who can rewind time: a long violet-black ponytail held with a gold clock hairpin, a white haori with pink trim over plum hakama, and a blade of pink light. Stoic, few words. She does her combo; then she rewinds the whole roof, Elfy included, and does it again faster. Then she rewinds once more, much too far.
notes: The combo. Hand on the hilt, menace rising: ... Then ZAN! A dash down a flickering lane that stops just short, a low crescent along the floor (jump), a high crescent (crouch), a rising slash, SHING! Every crescent's lane flickers first.
The plunge. She leaps to the high slab, blade point-down; a line is drawn from her to your spot. DON! She plunges into it (dash away), and a shockwave runs out both ways (jump). TOO SLOW.

The rewind (phase two). << REWIND: a clock face spins backwards behind the roof, tracking lines roll across the picture, and everything runs back to the start, Elfy included. Then the same combo again at one and a half times the speed, with a pink ghost of her first pass a beat behind her. AGAIN?

The counter. ...COME. Eyes shut, a pink ring tightening round her, then she cuts eight ways, every ray dashed first: stand in a gap. The second burst is turned half a step: jump into the next one. After the guard-and-counter-burst pattern.

The slide slash. HAA! From a crouch, because you are far away, she slides the whole floor at you (double jump), then flips back over you. ...NOT BAD. After the crouch-then-slide decision in the research.

Too far, the weak window. ONE MORE TIME! She rewinds again, and it's this morning: pajamas, nightcap, pillow, fast asleep standing up. ...ZZZ. FIVE MORE MINUTES... Elfy hits her three times. She wakes: !? D-DON'T LOOK!! FAST-FORWARD >>, and back to now.
fights.alt: On the sunset rooftop a stoic girl with a pink light saber dashes along a flickering lane and stops short of Elfy, throws a low crescent that Elfy jumps and a high one Elfy crouches under, does a rising slash, then leaps to the highest slab and plunges onto Elfy's spot as Elfy dashes away and jumps the shockwave; a clock face appears and the whole scene runs backwards, Elfy included, then the combo repeats faster with a pink ghost of her a beat behind; she rewinds again, too far, and appears in pajamas with a nightcap and a pillow, asleep, while Elfy hits her three times; she wakes, blushes, says don't look, and fast-forwards back

fights.name: Copycat Marcel
fights.eyebrow: 4 · the Wall, the Box, the Lasso, the Mirror, the Box Again · a mime whose mimes are real
fights.lede: A psychic mime: white face, black teardrop marks, a beret, a striped shirt, white gloves. Whatever he mimes is real. While he is miming it, it shows as a dashed outline (the warning); when it becomes real it turns to shimmering glass. He never says a word, only punctuation.
notes: The wall. He closes his eyes and feels for it with flat palms; a dashed wall appears in front of him, an arrow beside it. Then SHOVE: it turns to glass and slides the whole length of the roof. Be up on a slab.
The box. ! He strains under a heavy box over his head (dashed), and the slab you are standing on is marked. He throws it, THUNK. Be off it.

The lasso. He twirls it, throws it, YOINK: it loops round Elfy and reels her in toward his outlined punch. HO HO~. Jump the moment the rope goes taut: TWANG, it snaps, and she double-jumps right over him. WHIFF. ?!

The invisible man. SHHH... He fades out, all but his white gloves, which give him away: each lunge is dashed out from them first. Along the floor (get up on a slab), an uppercut onto your slab (get down), back along the floor (double jump). After the camouflage-and-hidden-lunge pattern.
The balloon animals. He blows up four balloons, SQUEAK, and they drift after Elfy; the ring of each pop is outlined before POP POP POP! Outrun them. After the bubble-burst pattern.

The mirror (phase two). He backflips away and a pane of glass stands between them; on the other side of it he copies Elfy exactly, step for step, jump for jump. Then he punches it out, CRASH, and its shards land on ringed spots on her side. Stand in the gap.
The box again, the weak window. ?!?! He mimes being trapped in a box, and the box is real. Elfy hits it three times; the third, SHATTER! Dizzy, he bows deeply (MERCI.) and moonwalks home.
fights.alt: On the sunset rooftop a mime feels for an invisible wall, outlined, then shoves it as glass along the whole roof while Elfy waits on a slab; he mimes a heavy box over his head and throws it onto her slab as she drops off; he twirls a lasso, catches Elfy and reels her toward an outlined punch, and she jumps the moment the rope is taut, snapping it and sailing over him; he backflips away and a glass mirror appears between them, and he copies her every move from the other side; then he punches the mirror out and glass shards land on rings while Elfy stands in the gap; he mimes being trapped in a box, the box is real, and Elfy hits it three times until it shatters; dizzy, he bows and moonwalks home

fights.name: Pom-Pom Pyra
fights.eyebrow: 5 · the Cheer, the Cartwheel, the Pyramid, the Victory Twirl · pyrokinesis, school spirit
fights.lede: A pyrokinetic cheerleader: a red and gold uniform with a big P, a white pleated skirt, a high ponytail that burns at the tip, and pom-poms that are balls of fire. Her cheers are her attacks: GIMME A G! and a giant burning G drops on you. Relentlessly peppy.
notes: The cheer. READY? OKAY! GIMME A G! She throws her pom-poms up, and a giant G is outlined right where you stand; a beat later it falls on that spot, burning, FWOOM. GIMME AN O! Then WHAT'S THAT SPELL?! and the exclamation mark. Three spots, three dodges, each letter burning a while after it lands.
The cartwheel. The lane flickers; CARTWHEEL! She wheels the length of the roof, leaving a trail of fire along the floor, and bounces off the wall, BOING, up onto a slab. TA-DAA! Be high.

Spirit fingers. SPIRIT FINGERS! Six arms of fire wheel out of her jazz hands, each set dashed first. The first set misses you; the second is turned onto exactly where you stood, so drop to the floor between its arms. After the rotating spiral-burst pattern.

The spirit chain. SPREAD THE SPIRIT!! The floor flickers, she slams her pom-poms down, FWOOOOM, and columns of fire march wall to wall one after another. Be up on a slab. WOO! GO TEAM! After the chain of flame pillars in the research.

Pyramid formation (phase two). Six fire pom-poms stack into a pyramid over her head, and she launches them one by one onto rings where Elfy just was: the high slab, then the floor, then the floor further on. Keep moving, and climb onto the far slab.

The victory twirl, the weak window. AND A ONE, AND A TWO... she twirls, and twirls. WHEEE... Dizzy, she topples off her slab, PLOP, and her flames go out, FSSS. Elfy hits her three times. GO, ELFY! ...WAIT, NO!
fights.alt: On the sunset rooftop a cheerleader with fire pom-poms shouts gimme a G and a giant burning letter G, outlined first where Elfy stands, drops onto the spot as Elfy runs clear; then an O, then an exclamation mark; she cartwheels the length of the roof leaving a burning trail while Elfy climbs to the highest slab; she backflips onto a slab, calls pyramid formation, and six fire pom-poms stacked over her head are launched one by one onto wherever Elfy just was as Elfy runs and climbs; she does a victory twirl, gets dizzy and topples off her slab, her flames gone out, and Elfy hits her three times; she cheers go Elfy, then realises

fights.name: Frostbyte
fights.eyebrow: 6 · the Skate, the Curtain, the Rink, the Triple Axel, the Sneeze · cryokinesis, too cool
fights.lede: A cryokinetic too-cool kid: an ice-blue swoop of hair over one eye, big headphones, a navy hoodie with a snowflake on it, and his hands in his pockets the whole fight. Lids half down, one-word lines. He skates. He does not, it turns out, wear a scarf.
notes: The skate. YAWN. ...CHILL. He snaps his fingers, a lane of floor flickers, and he skates the length of it, hands still in his pockets. TCH. Spikes of ice burst up along his trail (outlined first). Be up on a slab.

The curtain. LET IT SNOW. He points one finger up, and every column of the roof is outlined but one, its spot ringed. Icicles fall down all the others. Find the gap. AGAIN.: a second curtain with the gap somewhere else.

The ice statues. STAY FROSTY. He breathes two blocks of ice into being, his smirk frozen in each, then skates up and kicks them along the floor, KIK!, each lane dashed first. Jump, jump. After the ice-statue pattern.

The blizzard. BRRR-ING IT ON. Spikes grow along the far wall (outlined first) and a gale shoves Elfy toward them; keep running against it until it drops. ...MEH. After the blizzard and wing-gust patterns.
The rink (phase two). ...FINE. Headphones on, head nodding, TSS TSS, and the whole roof freezes. Get up on a slab.

Single, double, TRIPLE! He skates and spins into an axel that lands on the slab you are on (its ring outlined), bursting into spikes: left, high, right. Hop ahead, slab to slab, and drop to the floor for the last one.

The sneeze, the weak window. ...FLAWLESS. AH... AH... ACHOO!! He sneezes himself solid into a block of ice, eyes wide. Elfy jumps up and hits the block three times; the third, SHATTER! B-B-BRR... ...WHATEVER.
fights.alt: On the sunset rooftop a cool kid with headphones and his hands in his pockets snaps his fingers, freezes a lane and skates the length of the roof while Elfy waits on a slab, and ice spikes burst out of his trail; he points up and icicles fall down every outlined column but one, and Elfy runs to the gap, twice; he puts his headphones on and the whole roof freezes into a rink, then does a single, double and triple axel, each landing on the slab Elfy is standing on, its ring outlined first, as she hops ahead slab to slab; he lands, says flawless, sneezes and freezes himself in an ice block, and Elfy hits the block three times until it shatters; shivering, he says whatever

fights.name: Anchor Annie
fights.eyebrow: 7 · the Slab Slam, the Well, Upsy-Daisy, the Heavy Drop · gravity, density
fights.lede: A gravity kid, small and unimaginably heavy: twin buns, a sailor collar with a gold anchor on it, a red bow, and gauntlets as big as her head. She pulls the floating slabs down out of the air, opens wells that drag you in, throws pieces of the roof up and lets them fall. Very touchy about her size.
notes: The slab slam. HMPH! GET DOWN HERE! She reaches up, and the floor under a floating slab is outlined: the slab comes down onto it, THOOM, sits a moment, and floats back up. Then the middle one. Get out from under.

The well. SQUISH TIME~ A sphere is outlined on the floor, then it is a black hole with a violet rim, and everything on the floor streams toward it. Elfy runs and still slides. Jump up onto a slab before it bursts, KA-WHUMP.
The orbit. ROUND AND ROUND! Chunks of roof wheel round her on a ring that keeps growing outward; when it reaches your slab, be in a gap. After the expanding-ring pattern.

The cannonball. ANCHORS AWEIGH!! She curls into a ball and her whole route is dashed: along the floor, off the wall, past your slab (jump), off the sky, off the far wall and home. After the jump-and-roll and bouncing-orb patterns.
Upsy-daisy (phase two). FWUMP: four chunks of roof lift out of the floor into the sky and hang there, each over an outlined ring. Get down between them before she drops them all at once, CRASH!
The heavy drop. HEAVY DROP!! She leaps clean out of the picture. A ring follows Elfy across the floor, then locks, flashing white. Dash.
Dense, the weak window. KRAKOOM!! She made herself so heavy she went straight through the roof to her waist. ...UH OH. Elfy hits her three times (MY BUNS!). POP: I'M NOT SHORT! I'M DENSE!!
fights.alt: On the sunset rooftop a small girl with twin buns and big gauntlets reaches up and drags a floating slab down onto the floor beneath it, its zone outlined first, as Elfy dashes out from under, then the middle slab; she opens a black gravity well on the floor that drags Elfy toward it as she runs, and Elfy jumps onto a slab before it bursts; she lifts four chunks of roof into the sky where they hang over outlined rings, and Elfy drops down between them before they fall; she leaps out of the picture, a ring tracks Elfy across the floor and locks, Elfy dashes, and she lands so heavily she goes through the roof to her waist; Elfy hits her three times; she pops out shouting that she is not short, she is dense

fights.name: The Magnificent Cerebrax
fights.eyebrow: 8 · Telekinesis, the Mindlings, the Ultimate Brain Beam, One Thought Too Many · the final act
fights.lede: The one holding up the slabs: a small boy with an enormous pink brain under a glass dome, a monocle, a violet cape with its collar up to his ears, riding a hover-saucer. He monologues. He throws the roof at you, sends little brains after you, fires the ultimate brain beam, and then thinks one thought too many.
notes: Telekinesis. BEHOLD!! MWAHAHAHA! His brain glows and he tears the middle slab out of the air, shaking, lowers it to a lane that flickers along the floor, and hurls it spinning: jump. Then the right slab, down a lane at head height: crouch. FOOLISH ELF! They float back into place.
The synapse curtain. SYNAPSE! Two orbs part to the walls and a bolt joins them, its line dashed first: low (get up on a slab), then high (get back down). After the electric-curtain pattern.
The brainstorm. A cloud of thoughts rains down every dashed column: stand between two, then shift half a step for the second wave. After the ceiling-rain pattern.

The mindlings (phase two). MINDLINGS, ATTACK! Three little winged brains pop out of his dome and circle. One at a time, each locks a dashed line onto where Elfy is standing and dives, SPLAT, leaving a puddle a moment. Dash, dash, dash.

The ultimate brain beam (phase three). ULTIMATE... BRAIN... BEAM!!! It charges with menace marks rising, its path and the whole floor outlined; then the beam's foot sweeps the floor from one wall to the other in sparks. Get up on a slab.

One thought too many, the weak window. ...WAIT. IF I'M SO SMART... ERROR!? The dome fogs, the saucer dies, and he drops to the roof, CLONK, dizzy and sparking. Elfy hits the dome three times; the third, CRACK! MY BEAUTIFUL BRAIN! THIS ISN'T OVER!!
fights.alt: On the sunset rooftop a small boy with a giant brain in a glass dome hovers on a saucer, laughing; he tears the middle slab out of the air and hurls it spinning down a low lane as Elfy jumps it, then the right slab down a high lane as Elfy crouches; three little winged brains pop out of his dome, each locks a dashed line onto Elfy's spot and dives, splatting, as she dashes away three times; he charges the ultimate brain beam with menace marks rising, and its foot sweeps the whole floor while Elfy waits on a slab; then he stops, wondering, errors, his dome fogs, and his saucer drops to the roof; Elfy hits the dome three times until it cracks; he rises shouting this isn't over

studies.title: Ozeki Kappa, in the Round · Save Sparky devlog (study)
studies.name: Ozeki Kappa, in the Round
studies.tagline: Can a fight live inside an isometric miniature? Yes, with a track and a depth buffer.
studies.eyebrow: Save Sparky devlog · study · diorama test · the last bathhouse, floating
studies.lede: Can the fights live inside an isometric pixel-art diorama? Here the bathhouse from realm 8 is a cutaway floating in the rain at night: cedar posts and indigo tiles, the mural, the shoji glowing, the acid pool steaming, lanterns swaying, a ghost attendant drifting past with a towel. Everything is drawn by code at 640 × 360 and scaled up with sharp pixels. The fight inside it is the same 2D fight as before. Elfy only moves forward and back along a track (the cyan line), plus up. The inset in the corner shows that game, the real one, as plain 2D.

fights.name: The bathhouse diorama
notes: The game is 2D. Elfy and the kappa have a distance along the track and a height, nothing else; jumps, crests, salt rings, palms and hit windows are the bathhouse fight from realm 8, unchanged. The inset draws exactly that: a line of floor, the pool, the bridge's hump, the loft, the corner (dashed), Elfy as a green square, the kappa as a red one.

The world is a path. The track is a line through the 3D bathhouse: along the front of the room, over the bridge, out of the end door, round the corner onto the veranda. Each frame, every (distance, height) is put on that line and projected 2:1 isometric.

Depth per pixel. The room is drawn once into a color buffer and a depth buffer; characters, steam, splashes and the curtain check that depth as they draw, so the bridge rail, the loft's post and the doorway pass in front of Elfy, and the back wall stays behind her, with no hand sorting.

Telegraphs survive the trip. Rings on the track become isometric ellipses, lanes become lines along the track at the right height, arcs are drawn in the world. The grammar is the same: outline first, then the real thing.

Enemies can leave the track. The kappa walks back into the room to refill its dish at the pool, and steps aside to bow Elfy through. Off the track it cannot touch her (in the inset it turns to a dotted square); it is only dangerous on the line.

The camera. It looks at the room from a little in front rather than square on its corner, so the track runs nearly level across the screen and the room reads like a stage; depth goes down to the left. The camera never quite stops: its angle sways a few degrees over about fourteen seconds, and it drifts toward the middle of the fight (averaged over the last second, so the kappa's leaps don't jerk it). Because the whole room is redrawn from code every frame (about 12 ms), any angle is free, and every pixel reads its own spot on the textures, so the boards don't shimmer as it moves.

The corner. Where the track turns, the camera swings a quarter turn around the house, so forward is still to the right. The scene is redrawn from code at every angle of the turn: no second set of art. Halfway round, the cut moves with it, the way a dollhouse would be built: the end wall is cut away and the front wall goes back up, so you still look into the warm room from the new side.
Light on the characters. Elfy and the kappa pick up the lanterns (warm) and the moon (cool) by where they stand, so they read in the room's dark corners and change color as they cross it.
fights.alt: A cutaway bathhouse floats on a rock in the rainy night, drawn in isometric pixel art; inside, along the front of the room, Elfy fights Ozeki Kappa: it stomps and crests of floorboards run along the track, it throws salt onto rings, leaps the pool, fires palms of force; Elfy bows, it bows back and spills its dish, and she hits it; then it walks off the track back into the room to refill its dish at the pool and leaps home, steps aside and bows her through, and she runs out of the end door; the track turns the corner of the house and the whole diorama swings a quarter turn so she keeps running down and to the right, along the veranda into the back garden, where a ghost waves from the round window

studies.title: The Silk Spire · Save Sparky devlog (study)
studies.name: The Silk Spire
studies.tagline: A perspective-camera level with a spider on the ceiling: the one we threw out, kept for the lessons.
studies.eyebrow: Save Sparky devlog · study · level study · a realm of the climb
studies.lede: A level, not a diorama: one realm of the climb, with its one boss. Elfy arrives from below, up the steps from the bridge she came by. She meets Nana Nightloom, a knitting granny spider who walks the floor, the walls and the ceiling. She wins, the web over the hatch unravels, and she climbs out to the terrace, where the realm's gate is its checkpoint and the next realm hangs above her, lit gold. The game is still a flat 2D plane (the inset). The world around it is built in depth all the way out: a colonnade you see straight through, floating stairs and islands, towers, a city of spires in the fog, a sea of cloud far below. Everything is drawn by code.

fights.name: Nana Nightloom's chamber
notes: The camera trick. Instead of lowering the camera to see the ceiling, the camera's eye rides at Elfy's height with a gentle perspective. Anything above her eye shows its underside, so the ceiling Nana walks on is always in view while Elfy is below it. Anything below shows its top, so the floor she stands on, and the steps she came up, read as surfaces. Nothing tilts, and her controls never change.

The plane is 1:1. The camera's distance equals its focal length, so the play plane renders at exactly one world unit per pixel. Elfy, Nana, the platforms' front edges and every warning are crisp, unscaled pixel art. Only things in front of or behind the plane grow or shrink.

Walls and ceilings in 2D. In the inset, the chamber is a box of lines: floor, two walls, a ceiling with the hatch, two ledges. Nana is a red square that walks all of them; her lap is one path round the box. On screen she is drawn in her own frame (her surface below her), then turned onto the floor, a wall or the ceiling.

No void. The spire is open: a colonnade behind the chamber, and below it a bare framework of pillars, beams and hanging lanterns, so the world shows through. Around it, at every depth: two towers and a bridge, flights of floating stairs, small islands with lit houses, a city of spires, an aqueduct, a cloud sea. Fog thickens with distance, so it fades instead of ending, and everything slides past at its own rate as the camera rises.

Where you came from, where you are going. At the start the camera is low: the terrace, the long bridge off into the fog, the bathhouse far down it (the last realm), and the chamber's underside above. At the end it rises past the terrace to the gate, the checkpoint, and the next realm's golden island overhead.

One enemy, once. A realm has its boss; when she is beaten, its top opens (here, the web over the hatch unravels), and the gate at the top is the save point. An enemy you left unbeaten could follow you up through that hatch into the next realm, so two fights overlap.
fights.alt: Elfy climbs up a series of floating steps inside an open stone spire at night, a long bridge behind her running off into the fog, and comes up through a hole into a chamber framed by pillars, with a colonnade of tall arches behind it opening onto towers, floating stairs and islands and a city of spires; a granny spider in a lace bonnet and spectacles knits upside down on the chamber's ceiling, drops on a thread, runs a lap of the whole room along the floor, up the wall, across the ceiling and down the other wall, drops twice onto Elfy's spot, spits web onto the floor, then runs another lap trailing silk, snags in her own thread and dangles in a cocoon while Elfy jumps and hits her; she comes apart in silk, the web over the ceiling hatch unravels, light pours down, and Elfy jumps up to the terrace where a gate lights up as the checkpoint, a golden island floating high above

studies.title: The Rime Chapel · Save Sparky devlog (study)
studies.name: The Rime Chapel
studies.tagline: Saint Rime, circled: a chapel you walk round, the whole miniature turning a quarter at each corner.
studies.eyebrow: Save Sparky devlog · study · level study · Saint Rime, all the way round
studies.lede: Saint Rime, the Frost Chandelier from realm 3 (the one that skitters across the ceiling and down the walls), in a miniature. A frozen chapel sits on a floating rock under an aurora, with a cloister walk round all four sides and open rafters overhead for it to hang from. The camera is close, looking at one side almost face on, and the track runs right round the building. When the fight goes round a corner, the whole miniature turns a quarter with it, the way Fez turns its world. Some attacks are dodged by ducking round the corner. Everything is drawn by code.

fights.name: Saint Rime, the Frost Chandelier
notes: The miniature, up close. The same isometric pixel-art renderer as the bathhouse, but the camera is in close, so you see one side of the chapel at a time: the stone wall with its stained-glass lancet, the walk, the rafters, the lanterns, the snow-heavy roof. The far mountains, aurora and floating rocks are painted flat behind and slide as it turns, so there is always something out there.

Round and round. The track is a loop round the chapel, four sides long. When the fight goes round a corner, the miniature turns a quarter under the camera, so the side you are on always faces you and forward is always to the right. The columns of whichever side is nearest the camera are cut away, dollhouse-style; the rafters stay, because it hangs from them.

Dodge round the corner. The frost breath shoots straight down one side of the building and out past the corner into the air. Its whole line is dashed first. The answer is to run back round the corner, out of the line, and wait for it to finish. A wall at a corner is cover.
Following it round. It crawls the rafters round corners too, and Elfy has to follow. Its spike waves run along the track, so they can come round a corner at you.

Its moves (from realm 3): the crawl that grows icicles along the rafters (their shadows sharpen on the walk before they snap); the frost breath; the drop with a wave of ice spikes, then the wreck you hit; and in phase two, the pendulum swing on a chain (crouch), the snap, the crash. Its mask ticks round to a new face before each one.

The game is still 2D. The inset shows the loop unrolled into one long line, with the corners dashed. Elfy (green) and the chandelier (red, up at rafter height) move along it, and that is all the game knows about.
fights.alt: A snow-covered stone chapel with stained-glass windows floats on a rock under an aurora, a cloister walk with wooden rafters round all four sides; a chandelier of black iron with six hooked legs, cold blue candles and a porcelain mask hangs from the rafters over Elfy, crawls along them growing icicles that drop onto the walk, then crawls round the corner; the whole miniature turns a quarter as Elfy follows it; on the next side it climbs down the chapel wall and screams a beam of frost the length of the side and out past the corner, while Elfy hides round the corner; it crosses back over her and drops, a wave of ice spikes running along the walk, and lies wrecked while she hits it; it winches up and crawls round the next corner, the miniature turns again, and it swings on a chain like a pendulum until the chain snaps
